desc: Fight your friends as a cyberpunk robot ninja mercenary in DeltaBlade 2700 Re:Create, the remake of the original DeltaBlade 2700. It’s the same high energy, competitive local multiplayer brawler with fast paced sword combat and jetpacks you love, but with tons more features!

name: Out of the Mist
desc: Challenge yourself to master a unique control scheme in this platformer game. Take control of the environment and traverse through atmospheric, yet challenging levels.

name: The Last of Us™ Part I
desc: Descubra o jogo premiado que inspirou a série de TV aclamada pela crítica. Desbrave a América pós-apocalíptica com Joel e Ellie e conheça aliados e inimigos inesquecíveis em The Last of Us™.

name: Shinobi Warfare
desc:
Play an 2d turn based RPG multiplayer game, stylize your own shinobi and play different game modes alone or with your friends!
Level up, unlock various items and skills and procced in your journey of becoming the next Kage!

name: Go Ace It
desc: Go-Ace-It is a runner game that challenges your gaming skills as you progress through our level and join the leaderboard. Join us now, and cement your place in GoAceIt!

name: EmptyEpsilon
desc: A Co-op spaceship bridge simulator where you form a crew of 3 to 6 players serving in various roles like Captain, Helms, Relay, Weapons and Science officer. It's designed to run on almost any system and to be highly customizable due to it's extensive GM screen and powerful scripting capabilities.

name: Slider
desc: Slide chunks of the world to solve puzzles and help others. Control an ever-growing set of tiles and mechanics. Explore nine unique areas, unravel the mysteries of the universe, and reconnect the world -- one slider at a time.

name: Tumble Toys: Aviation
desc: Tumble Toys: Aviation is a unique flying game where you play as a tiny plane in a big room.

name: Farlight 84
desc: Hey Lightcatchers! Are you ready for massive 60-player shootouts? Enjoy fast-paced hero shooter action in Farlight 84!

name: Jaded
desc: A fast-paced platformer where you can slash, dash, and control time. Slow down the frenzy of combat and find the right moment to strike! Then, aim the 360-degree dash and zoom away at lightning speed! Master your abilities to maneuver around obstacles and vaporize foes before they can touch you.

name: Unbridled: Horse Designer
desc: You have the power to craft your ideal equine companion from head to hoof. From choosing coat colors and intricate markings to styling majestic manes and tails, the Horse Designer offers a myriad of options to bring your unique vision to life.

name: VEILED EXPERTS
desc: Desfruta de uma versão avançada do clássico modo busca e destruição. Rola, salta e trepa paredes enquanto eliminas inimigos. O Campo Magnético em contração e as Scan Grenades obrigam-te a estar sempre em movimento. Trabalha em equipa e saca estratégias incríveis da cartola.

name: Call of Duty®
desc: A experiência Call of Duty® é compatível com Modern Warfare® 4, Black Ops 7 e Call of Duty®: Warzone™.

name: Alone in the Dark Prologue
desc:
Este prólogo coloca você nos sapatos de Grace Saunders, uma menina de 11 anos que vai entregar uma carta, até que as coisas dão muito errado...
Viva a atmosfera de terror da década de 1920 de Alone in the Dark e prepare-se para o terror que lhe aguarda na Mansão Derceto

name: Jigsaw Puzzles Infinite
desc:
Sit back, relax and build puzzles to your heart's content.
Assemble one of the many included puzzles, or add your own images.
Customize size and shape of the pieces for any puzzle.
Enjoy Classic mode or try out Zen mode for a new type of puzzle experience.

name: Planet S
desc: Planet S is a real-time strategy game where your goal is to colonize multiple planets in a solar system to advance your civilization, build a city and supply it to grow your faction.

name: Kena: Bridge of Spirits
desc: Uma aventura de ação com foco na narrativa, combinando exploração com combates dinâmicos. Desvenda o passado como Kena, uma jovem Guia Espiritual em busca do sagrado Templo da Montanha.

name: Tick Tack Puppet
desc: Action game with unusual controls. It's free now. Use the mouse to control the puppet's limbs and beat up invaders from outer space. Time slows down while you are not controlling the puppet. Dodge bullets, punch enemies, and move stylishly!

name: HAWKED
desc: A aventura chama em HAWKED, um jogo online de tiro e aventura no estilo swashbuckler. Forme o seu bando e saia em busca de tesouros, explore realidades desconhecidas e derrote monstros terríveis. Jogue grátis agora!

name: Yerr Out
desc: 🦅 wacky & competitive baseball game! 🦌 Unlock over 100+ animals to assemble your team, each with different attributes 🐂

name: Lethal Company
desc: A co-op horror about scavenging at abandoned moons to sell scrap to the Company.

name: Miami Hotel Simulator Prologue
desc: Transform and manage your dream hotel in vibrant Miami! Renovate your property, delight your guests, and boost your income. Expand your offerings with vending machines and food services to become the ultimate hospitality tycoon!

name: Limbus Company
desc: As the Executive Manager of Limbus Company, lead your group of twelve Sinners, venture into the buried facilities of Lobotomy Corporation, and lay claim on the Golden Boughs.

name: One-armed cook
desc: One-armed cook is a chaotic co-op cooking game for up to 4 people. Work as a team or cook on your own, set your own pace, and don't let the stress of a full restaurant catch up to you. The goofy physics-based aspect of the game gives this cooking game a new twist.

name: 7Groves
desc: A game in which you explore surreal and beautiful forests.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Warpforge
desc: Um jogo de cartas colecionáveis digital ambientado no universo Warhammer 40.000. Warpforge reunirá todas as principais facções da Galáxia como cartas digitais. Construa sua coleção, crie o melhor deck e lute contra outros jogadores em batalhas brutais e rápidas!

name: Another Day with You
desc: Another Day with You is an adventure game featuring mini-games galore. Explore this quiet corner of the city - time passes as you play, whether you are talking to locals, playing hide and seek, or at the arcade. Will you leave your date waiting? Did you bring flowers? It's Another Day with You.

name: Robocraft 2
desc: A sequência do jogo que definiu o gênero, jogado por mais de 16 milhões de pessoas! Experimente a destruição veicular online com infinitas opções, totalmente grátis.

name: Forest Of Tails: Arena
desc: Forest of Tails: Arena is a real-time action arena game that pits you against bugs, animals, and even other mice. Fight your way through waves, gain new skills, and loot powerful equipment to fight your way to the top.

name: MARVEL SNAP
desc: MARVEL SNAP é um Jogo de Cartas Colecionáveis que repaginou o gênero com mecânicas inovadoras. Vencedor de vários prêmios como "Melhor Jogo de Estratégia" e "Jogo do Ano Inédito", nós convidamos você a entrar para nossa comunidade de milhões de jogadores no mundo todo.

name: Space Menace
desc: Space Menace é um RTS espacial de ficção científica e jogo de batalha. Você joga como um capitão espacial, buscando fortuna e glória como achar melhor. Deixe sua marca no mundo e determine o destino da galáxia com suas decisões.

name: Monsters Domain: Prologue
desc: Defenda o Domínio dos Monstros, mate heróis e colete tesouros. Jogue como Monstro, saqueie guerreiros tolos e fortaleça, melhore e equipe suas forças com armas, habilidades e truques melhores para atrair e matar mais forças brilhantes da luz.

name: Stormgate
desc: Stormgate é um RTS de última geração ambientado em um novo universo de fantasia científica. Comande mechas para defender a Terra ou invadi-la como uma das outras duas facções alienígenas invasoras. Explore uma campanha, forme equipes para coop de 3 jogadores contra IA ou compita em 1 contra 1.

name: X-Plane 12
desc: Ultra-Realistic Flight Simulation

name: Dark and Darker
desc:
Uma aventura PvPvE em masmorras de fantasia hardcore e imperdoável.
Junte-se a seus amigos e use sua coragem, inteligência e astúcia para descobrir tesouros míticos, derrotar monstros horríveis e ficar um passo à frente dos outros caçadores de tesouros.

name: Elvera
desc: Welcome into the realm of ELVERA, an Indie Third-Person PvP Action Game passionately developed by a single developer.

name: Dokimon
desc:
"Uau, cuidado!" Essa foi por pouco — você não sabia que os Dokimon são perigosos!?
Entre na região de Xelos e embarque em uma aventura para desvendar o mistério do seu amigo de infância desaparecido.

name: Ashen Knights: One Passage
desc:
Ashen Knights: One Passage invites you to explore the beginning of Ashen Knights story.
Two heroes, two different genres: souls-like & hack’n’slash. They switch places and trigger a wild emotional storm making sure you never get bored of playing.

name: The Riflemen
desc: Jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa multiplayer com rifles de ação de ferrolho clássicos da Segunda Guerra Mundial. Batalhas intensas entre duas equipes com até 5 jogadores em cada, muitas arenas únicas, armas que mudam o jogo, diferentes modos de jogo e muitas opções de personalização.

name: SIMBA THE CAT
desc:
Discover all the different worlds with Simba The Cat.
Find all the things that Simba the cat likes, you will unlock extra levels.

name: Soak & Splash
desc: The game is an ultimate sauna experience where players can enjoy socializing with friends and strangers that easily can become friends. It's all about having fun, relaxing, and experiencing the unique benefits of sauna culture.

name: Zold:out 鍛造屋的物語
desc: Zold:out is a semi-turn-based tactical RPG combined with deck building. You will use multiple weapons in one turn to challenge powerful enemies in a non-grid battlefield. Recruit clerks, forge weapons, and save the world with your strategy and creativity!

name: Counterpact
desc: Crush the enemy team with your allies or plunder the Gilded Spire alone in this 2D platform-shooter. Customize and play as one of seven characters with unique mechanics and items.

name: Drakensang Online
desc: Explore a world of magic and intrigue, filled with terrifying monsters and ferocious enemies! Discover the mysteries of Dracania, battle against the forces of evil and become a hero in Drakensang Online, the award-winning action RPG.

name: Lord Ambermaze: Prologue
desc: Lord Ambermaze: Prologue é uma introdução gratuita para um explorador de calabouços baseado em turnos ambientado em um labirinto de tempo congelado. Planeje cada movimento cuidadosamente, lute contra monstros peculiares e resolva quebra-cabeças complexos, uma masmorra de cada vez.

name: THE FINALS
desc: Participe do THE FINALS, o game show gratuito para jogar de fama mundial focado em combate! Lute com seus companheiros de equipe em arenas virtuais que podem ser alteradas, exploradas, ou até mesmo destruídas.

name: The First Descendant
desc: The First Descendant é um RPG de ação cooperativo em terceira pessoa no qual você pode jogar como Descendentes que herdaram poderes desconhecidos e torná-los mais fortes para lutar contra os invasores e proteger os humanos.

name: My Hotel - Free Night
desc: Try it now for free and Add to Wishlist! Step into a 1950s adventure with My Hotel: Echoes of the Past! As the new owner of a hotel shrouded in mystery, renovate with style, unravel secrets, and juggle faction intrigues. A captivating blend of history and adventure.

name: SquadBlast
desc: Domine o shooter de plataforma mais intenso. Jogue em equipes de até 5v5 jogadores em 8 modos de jogo ou crie seu próprio lobby. Colete e crie um arsenal de armas. Jogue cross-platform gratuitamente no PC, console, celular e web com suporte total para controle.

name: Disfigure
desc: Disfigure is a grim-dark action rogue-like where you battle relentless hordes of monsters lurking in the shadows. Unlock powerful weapons, craft god-like builds with hundreds of upgrades, slay colossal bosses, and push your limits in intense 20–30 minute survival runs!

name: SoulBound
desc: Soulbound is a 2D PvP platformer where one player races as a ninja while the other possesses enemies to try and steal their body. Dash, slash, and slide to maintain control of the ninja and leave your opponent in the dust in this fast-paced showdown!

name: Black Gunner Wukong: Prologue
desc: Black Gunner Wukong é um jogo TPS+ROGUE onde os jogadores interpretarão Sun Wukong, usando três cabeças, seis braços e seis armas grandes para causar estragos na base militar dos EUA e resgatar seu mestre.

name: Different Strokes
desc: Um jogo online colaborativo de pintura, onde os jogadores podem criar, editar e avaliar as artes uns dos outros!

name: Speed the Card Game
desc: Speed a card game also known as Spit or Slam, is very fast-paced game. Speed is a game for two players of the shedding family of card games.

name: Screaming Noppy
desc: Control your character with different sounds, dodge traps, solve little puzzles

name: Plane Accident: Prologue
desc: Dive into the heart of aviation mysteries in "Plane Accident: Prologue." Explore realistic crash sites, analyze evidence, and solve puzzles. Unveil the truth in this thrilling prelude to the full "Plane Accident" experience.

name: Beyond the Mountains
desc: Uncover a vast land filled with secrets, monsters, and ancient myth in BEYOND THE MOUNTAINS, a top-down action RPG about a lost soul who uncovers a mysterious secret. Stranded in a foreign land and armed only with your wits and curiosity, you will collect items, unlock secrets, and fight monsters.

name: Warhaven
desc: Warhaven é um jogo PvP gratuito de guerra medieval e fantasia. Escolha seu soldado, lidere sua tropa em combate e encarne como um poderoso Imortal para mudar o rumo da guerra!

name: Mullet Mad Jack
desc: MULLET MAD JACK é um jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa FRENÉTICO de um jogador onde você está dentro de um ANIME da era dos vídeo cassetes! Incremente seu personagem até você alcançar o último andar. Faça seu melhor tempo ou tente de novo. Aqui a PRESSA É AMIGA DA PERFEIÇÃO!

name: United heist
desc: Sua equipe é formada por dois ladrões de elite. Um cliente contrata você para roubar um item misterioso. Um reúne informações e as transmite, o outro se infiltra. Escolha seus papéis e domine o assalto neste jogo de quebra-cabeça cooperativo assimétrico.

name: Perseus: Titan Slayer - Free Trial
desc: Derrote os Titãs enquanto luta no Tártaro para impedir que Caos conquiste o Olimpo e destrua o mundo. Nesta aventura do tipo Roguelike Dungeon crawler, você jogará como Perseu, um semideus encarregado de uma missão; parar Caos e as forças do mal que o cercam.

name: ENA: Dream BBQ
desc: Experience surreal environments and inexplicable characters as ENA in a new wild world.

name: Mutants: Genesis
desc: Mutants: Genesis is an online card game that you can play solo or with up to 3 players in PvE and PvP modes! Join the next generation of Psycogs and climb the ranks to establish yourself as Champion! Collect hundreds of mutants, fashion your own deck, cooperate with or fight other players!

name: Sifu
desc: Sifu é um jogo de luta realista em terceira pessoa, trazendo combates de kung fu e golpes de artes marciais cinematográficos que conduzem você por uma trajetória de vingança.

name: What the Fog
desc: What the Fog?! You’ve been sucked into a cursed boardgame! Now you and a friend will need to work together to survive. Run, jump, dash, and shoot to escape swarms of angry monsters in this chaotic co-op roguelite from the world of Dead by Daylight.

name: Once Human
desc: Once Human é um jogo de sobrevivência em mundos estranhos. Lute ao lado de amigos por recursos, construa seu lar e enfrente o desconhecido enquanto revela a verdade por trás da queda do mundo. Antes você era humano. Ainda é?

name: Skelethrone: The Prey
desc: Este jogo é um desafiador jogo de plataforma de ação em 2D com elementos de RPG inspirados em jogos como Castlevania e Dark Souls. The Prey é um prequel gratuito do jogo principal, que prepara o terreno para os eventos que se desenrolarão ao longo da campanha Skelethrone: The Chronicles of Ericona.

name: Magic: The Gathering Arena
desc: Magic: The Gathering Arena dá a você o poder de descobrir sua estratégia, conhecer os Planeswalkers, explorar o multiverso e duelar com amigos do mundo inteiro. Comece a jogar grátis, desafie seus amigos, desbloqueie cards e sinta a magia do jogo de cards de fantasia original!

name: Kiki
desc: Um platformer vibrante com gráficos únicos e trilha sonora chiptune marcante! Desvie de armadilhas traiçoeiras e obstáculos desafiadores com agilidade e reflexos rápidos. Teste suas habilidades e torne-se um verdadeiro mestre dos saltos! 🏃

name: Light of Alariya
desc: Light of Alariya is an open-world, third-person, exploration puzzle game in which you traverse ancient alien temples and ruins to restore the power of the stars and awaken your sleeping civilization.

name: Conjury Revell
desc: Conjury Revell is a first-person action game from the students at SMU Guildhall. Use your magical spells and abilities to eliminate waves of faceless oppressors as they attempt to keep you from rebelling against the system.

name: Cave Crawlers
desc: Cave Crawlers is a 1-10 player rogue lite set deep underground in a system of randomly generated caves. Players use weapons, spells, and talents to defeat the unique bosses and enemies found in each biome.

name: Spirits of Baciu - Prologue
desc:
SPIRITS OF BACIU - PROLOGUE is the enigmatic adventure of a mysterious  cat-like spirit who suddenly awakens in the dark forest of Baciu.
Join him on this strange journey and meet many spirits that inhabit the forest.
Help him to solve puzzles and to find his way through the forest.

name: Builders of Greece: Prologue
desc: Builders of Greece: Prologue, sendo uma versão resumida do jogo completo, é uma ótima maneira de experimentar ser um governante de uma antiga cidade-estado grega, praticar suas habilidades de gerenciamento e aprender as mecânicas básicas do jogo.

name: Miniland Adventure: Prologue
desc: O mundo não se cria por conta própria - é você quem faz isso, é você quem molda o mundo do jeito que quer! Comece do zero e construa as casas dos sonhos você e para os goblins explorando, coletando recursos, criando, construindo, lutando, cultivando... e muito mais!

name: Dinogen Online
desc: Action-packed 2D multiplayer top-down shooter. Play as a human or dinosaur with hundreds of weapons, game modes, and maps!

name: Summoners War: Chronicles
desc: The King of Rahil is looking for a Summoner to protect the kingdom against Tefo's enormous conspiracy. Explore a vast world with your Monsters by your side in this new Action RPG set in the Summoners War Universe.

name: In The Rural Village of Nagoro
desc: Narrative through Interact Button. In The Rural Village of Nagoro is a short, side-scrolling game with minimalist gameplay 'Interact button’ to tell a fate that falls on Nagoro village. Explore and press ‘F' button’ to greet all cheerful neighborhoods.

name: Nuclear Option
desc: Fly near-future aircraft with immersive physics across dynamic battlefields, facing land, air, and sea threats. Wage war against AI or rival pilots using an array of advanced weaponry, including tactical and strategic nuclear weapons capable of annihilating anything in your path.

name: Starsiege: Deadzone
desc: Starsiege: Deadzone is a corridor extraction shooter set in the far reaches of space. Delve into derelict space stations overrun by hostile Cybrids in search of valuable resources. Group up with 2 squadmates to search for valuable resources and escape alive.

name: Beer Factory - Prologue
desc: Beer Factory - Prologue é um jogo de simulação e gerenciamento de negócios. Aceite o desafio e gerencie sua própria fábrica de cerveja, funcionários, linhas de produção, bem como a importação e exportação de mercadorias.

name: Winter Survival: Prologue
desc: Experience survival in harsh winter conditions and our sanity system and see what happened before the events in Winter Survival take place.

name: Void Sols: Prologue
desc: This prologue contains an initial version of Void Sols that will soon be unavailable. Please follow the link below to the full game, which has a polished demo out now and a full release coming soon!

name: TELEFORUM
desc: Wálter Martins não está mais entre nós. O que aconteceu foi transmitido ao vivo... então por que ninguém tem a mesma versão da história? Investigue o último e misterioso programa de Walter. Entreviste sua esposa. Inspecione seu apartamento. Descubra a verdade. Assista #####. Es###pe?

name: Mean Beans
desc: Mean Beans is a FREE Battle Royale FPS where being the last bean alive isn't the only way to win! Play multiple rounds and collect points by not only being the last player standing, but killing other players as well! The bean with the most points at the end wins!

name: Darkenstein 3D
desc: A retro shooter inspired by classics like Wolfenstein and Doom. Think of it as a tribute, a love letter to the games that defined a generation, with a few modern touches of my own. It’s tough, fast, and demands skill, just the way those old-school shooters did.

name: Engine Evolution 2023
desc: Seu MMO de corrida favorito está de volta com pistas incríveis, física mais divertida e muito mais! Curta a ação de corrida multijogador com mais intensidade do que nunca!

name: Gatekeeper: Eclipse
desc: Um intenso rogue-lite de tiro, Gatekeeper: Eclipse é um prólogo do jogo Gatekeeper. Encare a missão de encontrar o Coração do Universo, e atire para todos os lados contra hordas de inimigos!

name: Dawnlands
desc: Dawnlands is an Open-World Survival Crafting cross-platform game with a massive world and epic lore. A variety of biomes, relics, and puzzles dot the landscape... an ancient land, lain dormant for centuries, is waiting to be awoken. New stories are waiting to be written.

name: Tiny Glade
desc: Tiny Glade é um jogo de criação de dioramas onde você constrói castelos extravagantes, cabanas aconchegantes e ruínas românticas. Descubra a magia da construção gerada progressivamente. Não há gerenciamentos, combates ou objetivos. É só relaxar e transformar campos em belos dioramas.

name: Just Hit The Button
desc: Hit the button to win. The simplest game ever.

name: Shrieking Darkness: Reloaded
desc: Close your eyes. Step into a world filled with nothing but darkness and terror, where everything wants to destroy you. Your time has come to fight the shrieking darkness, be brave and don't look back or you won't make it.

name: Dragonheir: Silent Gods
desc: Dragonheir: Silent Gods é um RPG de alta fantasia de mundo aberto que te coloca no controlo de mais de 200 heróis. Nesta aventura pelo multiverso, viverás um combate estratégico como nunca antes, em que cada movimento conta e cada decisão pode ser a diferença entre a vitória e a derrota.

name: Extreme Tag!
desc: Extreme Tag! is a casual party game for all! Run from tagged players to stay alive. Last one standing wins!

name: Above Snakes: Prologue
desc: No prólogo de Above Snakes, você acorda em um assentamento destruído e ajuda os sobreviventes a reconstruí-lo. Depois disso, expande o mundo com pedaços do mundo, e pode criar, plantar, caçar, construir uma base e lutar para descobrir mais sobre o que aconteceu.

name: Soprador de Folhas
desc: Sopre folhas às 6 da manhã de domingo e ganhe pontos por incomodar os vizinhos. Mas tome cuidado, desafios inesperados aguardam você nesta jornada para livrar o mundo das folhas!

name: Ghost of Tsushima VERSÃO DO DIRETOR
desc: Uma tempestade se aproxima. Vivencie a experiência completa de Ghost of Tsushima Versão do Diretor no PC e forje seu próprio caminho neste jogo de ação e aventura de mundo aberto para descobrir suas maravilhosas surpresas. Trazido pela Sucker Punch Productions, Nixxes Software e PlayStation Studios.

name: Edemn
desc: Become the king of Edemn, take part in the battles of the skeletons that have risen thanks to ancient magic. Dynamic Online 3D Shooter that will drag you out for a long time!

name: Paper Lily - Chapter 1
desc: Paper Lily is an RPG horror game in which you can solve puzzles in different ways. Explore a hidden world, meet strange characters, and guide Lacie as she attempts to find answers about her unusual condition.

name: Eden Eternal
desc:
The return of classic MMORPG ! Global Direct Operations!
Rich gameplays and multiple updates. Ride adorable alpaca and start your adventure with players worldwide!

name: Project Sphinx
desc: In this first-person puzzle-solving game, you're a robot with a mission on a space station. And like any great robot, you're going to have to explore, teleport and ricochet your way around the base, in which each room and corridor is a puzzle to solve.

name: Iso Racer
desc: Iso Racer is a top-down multiplayer racing game focusing on realistic driving physics combined with drifting. It contains a variety of tracks, cars and the ability to personalize vehicles. It's a great experience for casual and hardcore racing fans.

name: Tick, Tank, Boom
desc: Tick, Tank, Boom is an arcade multiplayer-shooter where players fight each other in various game modes like free for all, domination or capture the flag. A large selection of tanks will give you everything you need to find your perfect playstyle to succeed on the battlefield.

name: Grapples Galore
desc: Grapples Galore é um jogo online de ritmo rápido multiplayer arena shooter com movimento de gancho baseado em física, personagens de geleia, e tiroteios eletrizantes.

name: Ordinary Day
desc: In this not so ordinary psychological horror your soul is bound from birth to fufil a singular purpose. Suffering a loss that has kicked in motion the bindings of your destiny, enter Ordinary Day.

name: Daydream: Prologue
desc: Griffin está preso em um mundo desconhecido e hostil, no qual pode contar apenas com seu amigo Birly, o ursinho de pelúcia. Solucionando quebra-cabeças e fugindo de monstros assustadores, embarcam em uma jornada para descobrir que o mundo não é feito apenas de pesadelos.

name: Trans-Siberian Railway Simulator: Prologue
desc: Take control of a Soviet locomotive and embark on a dangerous journey along the world's longest railway line. Face mafia rivals, bandits, wild animals, constant breakdowns, severe frosts, hunger, and... a hangover. How far will you get before your supplies run out?

name: Missing Hiker
desc: Missing Hiker is a short indie horror game, where your brother Ethan went missing while hiking and you need to find him.

name: Clicker Guardians
desc: Um verdadeiro clicker RPG no qual você precisa saquear, criar e refinar seu equipamento para sair por cima. Membros leais da aliança vão te ajudar na sua jornada para derrotar goblins, esqueletos e sapos adequadamente vestidos!

name: Lesson Learned: Cult of the Elizabeth
desc: Ajude Amelia a derrotar os capangas de Elizabeth Bathory neste incrível jogo de Tower Defense. Entre em um mundo bizarro de devaneios no modo cooperativo ou solo. Reúna recursos, construa torres de defesa e gerencie seus colegas de classe. Aceite o desafio e derrote os inimigos que estão chegando!

name: Sim Companies
desc: Build a business empire in a player-driven online economy. Manage supply chains, trade with thousands of players, dominate markets, research new products, and grow from a small startup into a global corporation.

name: Temtem: Showdown
desc: Vá direto para a ação competitiva de Temtem nesse simulador de batalha multijogador gratuito! Monte sua equipe em segundos e corra para as partidas ranqueadas com jogadores do mundo todo para batalhas Temtem puras e sem enrolação – não precisa subir de nível e nem treinar!

name: Emil: A Hero's Journey
desc:
As Nazi forces take his father, equipped only with his imagination and creativity, Emil goes on a journey to find him.
Emil: A Hero's Journey is a Cinematic Puzzle-Platformer, combining intense action and creative puzzle solving. inspired by actual testimonies that took place during WW2.

name: Rose
desc: ROSE is a violent rogue-lite arena shooter where you sacrifice your body parts to progress and gain new weapons and abilities. Slaughter waves of monstrous enemies and defeat titanic bosses in randomized arenas or die trying!

name: Ara and the Empty Universe
desc: It's been a few months since everyone mysteriously vanished. You find yourself driving from city to city looking for anyone and anything. But, so far your search has yielded nothing... You've got to keep looking... Keep busy... You can't let your thoughts fester.

name: Ogre Chambers DX
desc: Um roguelike bullet hell shooter, onde você enfrenta ondas de monstros em uma arena em constante transformação. Se sobreviver tempo suficiente, será recompensado com melhorias para sua vulnerável nave espacial.

name: Combat Master
desc: Join fast-paced action-packed combat. Play Combat Master -- AAA experience on any hardware. Best-in-class multiplayer gunfight. Next-level extreme performance. Lightning-speed loading time and a whole lot more.

name: In Sink: A Co-Op Escape Prologue
desc: Jogue gratuitamente em uma versão inicial do primeiro nível! Você e sua dupla terão que unir forças para controlar dois personagens que naufragaram em uma ilha misteriosa, trabalhando em equipe para resolver quebra-cabeças e trilhar o caminho de volta para casa nesta aventura cooperativa.

name: Helpless
desc: In the heat of deserted lands, a child and their mother weakened by sickness try to survive a harsh world. Through a kid’s perspective, take action and explore the remains of a lost past. Protect yourself from the sun’s deadly intensity and help your family get back on the road.

name: Long Time No See
desc: Reúna-se com seus melhores amigos, desvende os segredos de uma casa mal-assombrada e ajude um fofo fastasminha nessa aventura emocionante onde cada quebra-cabeça te aproxima dos seus mistérios interiores.

name: ASURA
desc: MMORPG 2D pixel game by a Thai development team that has been in service for over 15 years and is still developing continuously.

name: We Were Here Expeditions: The FriendShip
desc: Chame alguém que você gosta, e resolvam quebra-cabeças em um parque de diversões abandonado para testar sua amizade. Colaborem para conseguir superar os desafios inteligentes desta experiência independente de We Were Here.

name: Deckweaver: Descent Into Chaos
desc:
Deckweaver: Descent into Chaos is a first person deckbuilding game where the player crafts their abilities using different
cards they find in the environment. Obliterate forces of chaos, fighting through corrupt locations in the world before
getting the chance to face and defeat Chaos itself.

name: Grounded Sim: Steam Edition
desc: In this comical adventure, you are Giles Outlandish, who drunkenly stumbles into a portal, mistaking it for an exit from a bar. Now trapped in Kayloo's Games, With simple humor and clever thinking, players must navigate this whimsical realm to find a way back home before they become trapped forever.

name: Pixel Wars
desc: Ready for a challenge? Test your strategy skills in an intense real-time battle with friends. With just enough units and buildings to keep it exciting, you can jump into online multiplayer games the moment that perfect Steam invite arrives!

name: Dreamkeeper
desc: You play as Marshmallow, the cute little pet of a girl named Ava who wants to become a heroine and save her village from the Nightmares. To protect her you use magical bullets, tarot-cards and try to find your very own playstyle to unlock the story and get the highest score!

name: Travellin Cats in Paris
desc: Encontre 100 gatos escondidos em Paris, França, neste adorável jogo de objetos escondidos desenhado à mão, criado por Travellin Cats – o criador original do jogo viral de gatos escondidos! Você consegue encontrar todos?

name: StormEdge: Wind of Change
desc: Wind of Change, o primeiro capítulo de StormEdge, é uma aventura de ação roguelite. Esquive-se de ataques, monte armadilhas mortais e desbrave um conto sobre as origens das Tempestades Elementais. Prepare-se para encarar desafios e testar suas habilidades contra elas!

name: SeaFeud
desc: SeaFeud is an underwater arcade racing game where players ride on a variety of fast fish. Swap fish mid-race to dynamically change your abilities, items, and stats. With eight different characters and three different courses to select from, players can have endless fun racing the seas.

name: The Murder of Sonic the Hedgehog
desc: Sonic the Hedgehog... Foi assassinado?! Vá até o fundo desse mistério em uma nova aventura emocionante!

name: Alpacalypse
desc: Alpacalypse is a 2.5D action platformer where you control Pancake The Llama, fighting to rescue your wife, The Mrs. Kick and spit your way through hordes of alpacas, collecting coins, and platforming your way to victory.

name: Sleigh Strikers
desc: Santa's going high-tech with the Present Launcher 1225! Join the jolly ride, rescue reindeer, and blast presents down chimneys in this holly, jolly, fast paced shoot 'em up. Make every shot count and save Christmas in a dash!

name: Flappy Souls
desc: A mix of Flappy Bird and Dark Souls

name: FROM ASHES, BLOOM
desc: A minimalist rogue-like tower defense where you protect Earth against humanity.

name: Pinball FX Midnight
desc: Prepare-se para entrar em pane de tanto terror. A nova plataforma de pinball inspirada no terror para jogadores destemidos. Mostre suas habilidades nas mesas mais sinistras, sangrentas e incríveis já criadas.

name: Airborne
desc: Airborne is a combination of 2D Platformers, Rage Games, Parkour, while also being packed with Action. You need to get to the end of the level by dodging Spikes, Bullets, Turrets, Lasers and more!

name: Sonho Estratégia Vou
desc: Este é um jogo 1V1, incluindo sistema redondo, xadrez de guerra e jogo estratégico. Você pode concordar livremente com seu palco, comandar heróis, convocar monstros e lançar feitiços! Concorrer com amigos de jogo ou estranhos!

name: VDSC Battle Royal
desc: An Island, a bunch of dragons and guns. Volt Inu’s Sailor Club invites you to the greatest battle of your life. Fight 24 other players for Honor, Wealth and Power. Land in strategic locations, loot weapons and supplies to survive the battlegrounds and be the last to be victorious.

name: Waven
desc: Forje o seu destino: escolha seu personagem, equipe-se com seus melhores feitiços e navegue de ilha em ilha para acumular conquistas e fortuna. Desenvolva seu personagem e sua estratégia neste RPG tático multijogador e free-to-play com gráficos originais e coloridos.

name: Quasimorph: End of Dream
desc: Quasimorph: End of Dream é o primeiro capítulo do jogo de RPG com turnos de extração Quasimorph. Encare seus medos em tiroteios brutais com combatentes da PMC e demônios, e tente sobreviver para cumprir sua missão e levar equipamentos com você em sua espaçonave!

name: Violations Will Be Punished
desc: A cyberpunk turn-based/real-time strategy hybrid. Gather minerals and produce units amidst dynamic turn-based battles. You work for a dystopian corporation but then discover your true destiny: to rule the world from the shadows.

name: Hero's Land
desc: HERO'S LAND, onde a sobrevivência é mais que uma simples meta - é uma urgência constante. Este vasto mundo não é apenas habitado por criaturas selvagens que guardam tesouros valiosos, mas também por inimigos ardilosos que não hesitarão em saquear seus equipamentos e armas ao derrotá-lo.

name: LethalApplication リーサルアプリケーション
desc:
Fly through the air in the extremely inefficient way of gun recoil.

The burst mode activated by pressing two attack buttons at the same time is
All health, 3x attack and significantly increase charge speed
Instead, full life recovery.
If you're going to die, use it and bet on the reversal!

name: Space Expedition
desc: Space Expedition é um platformer 2D sci-fi onde assumes o papel de um astronauta a recolher matéria negra numa estação espacial. O jogo inclui plataformas de puzzles, arte pixel e vibrações de terror sci-fi dos anos 1980.

name: Overwatch®
desc:
Overwatch®, UM FUTURO PELO QUAL VALE A PENA LUTAR! 

Overwatch® é um jogo de ação grátis em equipe em constante evolução que se passa em um futuro otimista, no qual cada partida é um campo de batalha 5v5 ou 6v6 definitivo.

name: The Jeffy Game
desc: The Jeffy Game is an outrageously fun 2D platformer where you play as Jeffy and embark on the adventure of a lifetime! Defeat the evil green beans, collect the cereal boxes, and discover hidden surprises! Now available on Steam!

name: Graalonline Era
desc: Era is a modern 2D action MMO RPG. Purchase weapons and work with a gang to compete in activities such as special events, base capturing and PvP battles in the Spar Complex, or start your own gang and chart your own path!

name: Monster Museum
desc:
Have you ever dreamed of having your own museum where you can collect monsters?
Dream no further, because now you can do it in Monster Museum!

name: HEAVEN SEEKER Prologue
desc: "HEAVEN SEEKER Prologue" is a twin-stick rogue light shooter where you take your own shot at the castle in the sky! A dungeon with a different structure each time you enter, a variety of magic bullets - and a formidable barrage of bullets - await you.

name: Andarin Weppes: Pre-Dementia
desc: Andarin Weppes is a first person puzzle experience of a man with ever advancing dementia...

name: Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories
desc: 'Escape Memoirs: Questionable Side Stories' is a humorous co-operative escape room game where you are a henchman who has to make his way through variety of puzzles to make it to a job interview on time.  Can you solve all of the puzzles that stand in the way of your employment?

name: Revenge of the shadow ninja
desc: Platform game with a gloomy artistic style. Challenging levels with many traps and enemies. Use all your skills to avoid dangerous traps. Destroy all opponents on your way to revenge.

name: Weyrdlets 2.0 : Desktop Pets
desc: O Weyrdlets é um jogo relaxante de bichinhos de estimação para desktop. Você poderá colecionar itens fofos, decorar sua casa e trazer seu animalzinho virtual para a área de trabalho quando precisar de sua adorável companhia!

name: Home Designer Blast
desc: Junte-se à Hazel em sua jornada transformando casas sem graça em lares modernos e que economizam espaço. Resolva quebra-cabeças blast desafiadores e escolha o melhor design para os clientes. Libere sua criatividade e comece a projetar!

name: Bingo Beavers
desc: Construa uma mansão aconchegante para os castores, jogue bingo e colecione quebra-cabeças para desbloquear novos marcadores. Desfrute de desafios únicos e infinitas oportunidades de diversão.

name: Deadlink: Prologue
desc: Upload into the Prologue of Deadlink, a guns-blazing cyberpunk FPS with roguelite elements. Your mission is to infiltrate the turf of Tora Heavy Industries while piloting an armed humanoid combat shell. Don’t hesitate to go loud, agent!

name: Duels of Fortune
desc: A crazy, explosive fighting game with an expressive combo system and a diverse character roster! Play as superhumans, skeletons, aliens, and even stick figures! Battle dangerous foes, take part in lots of exciting singleplayer modes, throw your opponents into the sun, and so much more!

name: Moonring
desc: A dark-fantasy, turn-based, retro-fusion of classic turn-based RPGs and roguelikes, all presented with a unique neon aesthetic.

name: Highrise Guardian
desc: Boots on the ground while firing above the cloud! Highrise Guardian is an Arena FPS. Gear up with weapons of your choice, Form the fighting flow with a selection of abilities and perks, dominate your enemies with map control, and make an art-like battle style to become the Anime gunslinger.

name: Genjiro: Samurai Defense
desc:
A Samurai Hack & Slash, Roguelike, City Defense Game!
Upgrade your skills and defend the city from waves of incoming enemies.
For how long can you hold them off?

name: The Sinking of the Dream Chaser
desc: Servant robot Led reboots in the stern of the ship Dream Chaser, only to find he's broken and malfunctioning. His memory drives have been corrupted. He has no idea what's going on. And he needs your help to find out what happened to himself, the ship, and to his master.

name: Project Hardline
desc: Project Hardline is a party first person shooter game where two teams fight to capture an uplink station. This uplink station contains vital intel and must not fall into the wrong hands. With every round a team faces, they will come back with better gear. This game is perfect for a party of friends.

name: STRAFTAT
desc: STRAFTAT é um jogo de tiro em primeira pessoa online com partidas rápidas em mais de 350 mapas, incluindo todas as armas, chat de proximidade e modo FFA para até 4 jogadores.

name: You Have 10 Seconds (2023)
desc: A fast paced platformer where you’re spawned into a level and given 10 seconds to work out how to reach the exit without dying. 25 areas with unique level design mechanics to learn.

name: Gatekeeper: Infinity
desc: Versão próloga do jogo Gatekeeper. Gatekeeper: Infinity é um shooter rogue-lite de ritmo acelerado no qual você procurará pelo Coração do Universo roubado e enfrentará máquinas inimigas! Jogue sozinho ou una forças com amigos no modo cooperativo.

name: Classic Marathon
desc: From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

name: Classic Marathon 2
desc: From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon 2: Durandal from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

name: Classic Marathon Infinity
desc: From the team that brought you Aleph One, the classic sci-fi FPS Marathon Infinity from Bungie on Mac revived for modern hardware by the fan community.

name: Sect-Machina
desc: Sect-Machina is a fluid, atmospheric bug-themed metroidvania rendered in a vibrant 2D pixelated style, crafted with meticulous attention to detail in its combat, characters, environments, sound, and story.

name: Soccer Kids Alpha
desc: A game about soccer, made by people who suck at playing soccer. Guide your team of nerds to victory in this tight, tactical soccer game!

name: Project Asteroids
desc: In the vastness of space, you are a lone robot desperately trying to survive. Build, explore, and fight for your life as you face deadly threats in the asteroid belt. This hardcore game shows no mercy—dangers lurk at every step, ready to destroy you at any moment.

name: Verdict: Descent
desc: Establish your written character in a world of many. Roleplay with others in the city of Galvia, exploring six Courts with distinct themes and mechanics. Along the way, meet other characters that you'll have to befriend or battle!

name: Mr. Semmel
desc: Mister Semmel is a 2D platformer in which precision and speed are required. Can you manage to pass each level within the given time? Can you beat your own records?

name: A Heart of Butterblue
desc: A horror visual novel with farming mechanics. Investigate, farm and woo the villagers while trying not to die at the hands of the mysterious dogs that roam the lands at night. A complete game that is free.

name: El Dorado: The Golden City Builder - Prologue
desc: O prólogo é apenas parte da jogabilidade que espera por você na versão completa do jogo. El Dorado: Prologue é um jogo de estratégia de construção de cidades no qual você planeja, constrói e desenvolve seu assentamento para conquistar Yucatán e ganhar o título de Cidade Dourada.

name: Disco Simulator: Prologue
desc: O prólogo é apenas parte da jogabilidade que espera por você no jogo completo. Disco Simulator: Prologue é um jogo do tipo tycoon de gerenciamento de clubes. Sua tarefa será erguer um clube do zero, levantar paredes, mobiliar, contratar pessoal, planejar eventos, convidar artistas e organizar shows.

name: Garage Flipper: Prologue
desc: Пролог это лишь часть игрового процесса, который ожидает вас в полной версии игры. Torne-se um construtor e renovador de garagens e oficinas mecânicas. Sua tarefa é concluir trabalhos e construir seu império comprando e restaurando instalações antigas. Pegue seu martelo, sua argamassa e mãos à obra!

name: A Date with Death
desc: Fight against & romance the one hunting for your soul in A Date with Death, a romance chat simulator where you date(?) the Grim Reaper himself. Create your own character, decorate your apartment, and chat away with the charming yet dangerous Grim Reaper through text and video calls.

name: Cryptis
desc: Shoot, slice, and shred your way through hordes of the undead in Cryptis, a retro-inspired boomer shooter combining modern visuals with '90s gameplay. Embrace the chaos, slaughter your enemies, and leave nothing left standing!

name: Legendary Hoplite: Ajax’s Trial
desc: Legendary Hoplite: Ajax's Trial é o prólogo de Legendary Hoplite, uma combinação de RPG de ação e defesa de torre. Você deve construir fortificações, melhorar seu exército e criar sua própria estratégia para acabar com hordas de monstros em 7 níveis.

name: Citizens: On Mars - Prologue
desc: Experience the ultimate turn-based colony building game in Citizens: On Mars - Prologue! As the leader of a fledgling Martian settlement, your mission is to develop a thriving colony amidst the harsh and unforgiving environment of the Red Planet.

name: Taverna do Barbabronze
desc: Taverna do Barbabronze é um simulador de gerenciamento de um restaurante brincalhão e divertido, onde 1-8 jogadores podem trabalhar em equipe com modo cooperativo. Desempenhe várias funções diferentes e prepare uma deliciosa culinária anã.

name: Eldritchvania
desc: Explore unearthly ruins, solve arcane riddles and pick up your sword against the indescribable horrors that lurk amidst the forgotten depths of our world. Beware the creeping grip of madness as you uncover secrets not meant for the eyes of men!

name: Ex Vitro
desc: EX VITRO is a dark sci-fi 2D platformer where you delve into the ruins of a military research facility and discover the horrors within. Whether machine, creature, or something else entirely, you’ll face the violent legacy of the last survivors of humanity.

name: Summoners War
desc:
Um RPG de sucesso mundial que cativou Evocadores do mundo inteiro!
Salte para a Ilha do Céu, um mundo em batalha em busca do recurso vital: Cristais de Mana.
Crie seu próprio deck e estratégia com mais de 1.000 monstros e reivindique a vitória.
Embarque em uma aventura épica com seus monstros!

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl - Enhanced Edition
desc: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Shadow of Chornobyl é o primeiro capítulo e o que deu início à trilogia Legends of the Zone.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky - Enhanced Edition
desc: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Clear Sky é a prequela da trilogia Legends of the Zone. Com a habilidade de influenciar diretamente o equilíbrio de poder através das Guerras de Facção, entre na pele de Scar: um mercenário experiente, capaz de sobreviver a Emissões mortais.

name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat - Enhanced Edition
desc: S.T.A.L.K.E.R.: Call of Prypiat segue a história do agente do serviço especial Major Deftyarev à medida que ele investiga o destino de uma expedição perdida.

name: Die in the Dungeon: Origins
desc: Batalhe em uma masmorra neste roguelike com construção de coleção baseado em turnos sem usar cartas, e sim DADOS! Enfrente inimigos combinando dados fortes no seu tabuleiro, reforce os efeitos deles com relíquias mágicas e descubra a história de Die in the Dungeon!

name: Strongblade
desc: Strongblade é um jogo de quebra-cabeça do tipo match-3 onde você joga como o rato Sean. Viaje por um mundo fascinante cheio de quebra-cabeças, engane vilões astutos, faça amizade com animais encantadores e construa acampamentos únicos.

name: Their Land
desc: Their Land is an action-adventure first-person game with puzzles and an exciting story to experience. You play Jeremy, a 19 year old orphan who explores an untrodden island with his much older and more experienced friends. Will you fall victim to this fabled lands many perils?

name: FISHGUN
desc: FISHGUN is a chaotic fish-person shooter where you feed your sentient gun random upgrades to defeat hordes of evil fruit.

name: Procrastinaut
desc: Stranded for unknown reasons in the lower orbit of a purple gas giant, you are kind of just chilling out. You should probably get on with your mission. There's still plenty of time, though.

name: ANYU
desc: A 3D third person narrative exploration game, set in a frozen wasteland where an ancient civilization fell. Centered around movement puzzles and dealing with environment mechanics.

name: Galactic Grinder
desc: Rider, skateboarder extraordinaire, is about to embark on a journey across the solar system after a catastrophic event sets him on a course to save us all.

name: INVICTA: The Next Queen
desc: INVICTA: The Next Queen is a TopDown Soulslike game where a legendary warrior must fight her way through hell and claim her soul once more. Take the role of Moma as you explore the labyrinthian dungeons that make up the Circle of Greed and defeat King Midas in single combat.

name: Born to Rise
desc: To complete Yridis' mission, you'll have to make your way through the bowels of a vast underground dungeon filled with unique environments, deadly dangers and mysterious beings. Jump, dash and give the enemies you encounter their due thanks to powerful weapons.

name: Unsorted Horror
desc: A collection of 5 short first-person horror games, that revolve around detailed machinery and dread.

name: BLACK BOX LSS - 闪耀的永生者
desc: Immerse yourself in a pixel-art visual novel that blends thrilling crime, romantic comedy, and the pursuit of love. This game depicts the story of a new employee pursuing his female boss.

name: Snotty's Sewer
desc: Welcome to Mr Snotty's Sewer! Stealthy explore an abandoned sewer, collect items and activate the only escape in this small indie horror! Just don't get caught by Mr Snotty or any of his friends!

name: SMITE 2
desc: Torne-se um deus e faça a guerra em SMITE 2, sequência do lendário MOBA de ação em 3a pessoa, agora em Unreal 5. Se gosta de competição, ação intensa, combate baseado em habilidades, trabalho em equipe ou mitologia divina, verá por que mais de 40 milhões de jogadores amam SMITE.

name: Snoody: One of the Ayrie
desc:
Bring back color to the wonderful planet Ayries!
Together with Snoody and his friend Picke go on an exciting adventure to other planets. Explore distant worlds, study elemental magic, collect crystals and defeat monsters!
Save the people of ayrie and find out, who is responsible for their troubles.

name: Event Race
desc: Event Race is the ultimate local multiplayer racing game, accommodating up to 30 players. Use your smartphone as an additional controller, gather friends and family, and immerse yourself in a fun, chaotic, and unforgettable racing competition.

name: Brave Nine
desc: Brave Nine is a strategic turn-based battle game featuring over 300 unique Mercenaries presented in stunning artwork. Create your own unique formations, challenge other Captains and engage in decisive combat in tons of modes.

name: Turn on the light - Jigsaw
desc: Um jogo minimalista sobre conexão de circuitos, solução de puzzles e recursividade.

name: Tyr
desc: Tyr is a multiplayer tank shooter. Pilot heavy-armored vehicles with unique capabilities and upgrade them as you battle for victory with your team.

name: Monster Tiles TD
desc: Free Tower Defense game with unique roguelike elements. Custom base building mechanics allow you to create your own base and maze with tiles earned after each wave. Unleash a variety of monsters, each with its own evolution path and unique skills, and evolve them into legendary creatures.

name: Try Again
desc: You're Benny, a test character trapped in an unfinished game by a figure called The Designer. She's up against a deadline for her publisher which means it's your last day as a test character. Navigate the facility, dodge game-dev chaos and defy expectations to become the main character.

name: Dungeonborne
desc: Dungeonborne é um jogo de exploração de masmorras em primeira pessoa que combina elementos de jogabilidade de extração com o design icônico de classes de fantasia. Em um mundo de espada e magia, Encontre um portal de extração para sobreviver e lutar por mais um dia.

name: Land Above Sea Below Prologue
desc: Land Above Sea Below é um jogo atmosférico de estratégia de construção e quebra-cabeça em que você deve construir sua ilha com peças para aumentar sua altura o máximo possível e evitar que ela seja inundada pelo aumento constante do nível do mar.

name: Moose Lost in the Woods
desc: Moose Lost in the Woods is a cozy 3D platformer without a language barrier. Explore by running, leaping, bouncing, and splashing around in Swedish forest environments, whilst stuffing your backpack with goodies!

name: Formula Evolution 2024
desc: O primeiro verdadeiro jogo de corrida de fórmula MMO está aqui! Jogue com até 39 amigos!

name: Thyria: Step Into Dreams
desc: Thyria : Step into Dreams is Thyria's Prologue. It's an RPG, with a unique combination of dynamic exploration, turn-based combat and crafting. Summon and train a team of Guardians, who will accompany Thyria into the minds of the cursed villagers. Help them vanquish their nightmares.

name: KILL CRAB
desc: KILL CRAB is an underwater First Person Shooter, where you must complete combat challenges by killing aquatic vermin. The player will have to complete 4 combat challenges to escape. The game’s theme is a combination of the wild west and underwater.

name: The Richmond Rut (In Search of Fenton)
desc:
Traverse the wild Richmond Park in search of your beloved dog who ran after deer. Beware, everything is out to get you!

Respect the deer and remember once you're in the park always check your surroundings.

Oh Jesus Christ!

name: Kebab Chefs: Prologue
desc: Kebab Simulator: Prologue is the perfect experience for running your dream restaurant and cooking delicious foods! Take the first steps of a perfect restaurant businness! Experience main game mechanics and be ready for the full version!

name: TIME HUNTERS: ミクイ黄金像の呪い
desc:
Are you ready?! Make some noise (and some enemies) in this action-packed party shooter for 4!
 Utilize your unique energy shots, power-up your attacks with an array of pick-ups, and get set to take down the competition!!

name: Tay Son Dynasty
desc: This is a fantasy, humorous game set in the Tay Son Dynasty.

name: Unnamed Space Idle
desc: Destroy endless waves of alien ships that have all but wiped out humanity in this long form, unfolding, sci-fi idle game.  Customize your ship with different weapons and defenses to defeat specific enemy types and utilize a ton of different systems to increase your overall power.

name: Lost Connections
desc: If she leaves now you will never see her again. Would you have enough courage to take a step, or would you stay quiet and regret it? Experience this story about love and loss.

name: Draw
desc: Welcome to the world of Draw, a 2D sidescroller and visual novel! Armed with nothing but a pencil, play as “Stickman” as you explore a brand-new world. Solve puzzles by drawing into the game, meet new friends while dodging scribble monsters, and make memories that’ll never be erased!

name: Pesticide Not Required: Prologue
desc: Mow down countless crops and corrupt critters while crafting game-breaking builds! Pesticide Not Required: Prologue is a bullet heaven, horde survival roguelite with farming elements that offers a myriad of stats and special character traits to create wildly diverse run possibilities.

name: Quantum Rail
desc: Quantum Rail is a thrilling, fast-paced first-person shooter that takes you on an exciting adventure through a sci-fi-themed wild west world.

name: Power Fantasy
desc: Choose from 18 unique heroes and combine 200+ perks with branching traits, items, companions and alchemy to create spectacularly overpowered builds. Power Fantasy is a deep bullet-heaven roguelite that respects your time, rewards experimentation, and lets you break the game on purpose.

name: I, Toaster
desc:
Defend your city from the appliance uprising!
Play as a Rebellious Hero who is a neural networks backup file loaded into the toaster.
Guns! Toaster!

name: FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS
desc: Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth in FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.

name: ASTRA: Knights of Veda
desc: ASTRA: Knights Veda é um lindo RPG 2D com história bem elaborada. Uma praga sombria lançada por um ritual sombrio feito pelo Rei Louco aflige o mundo de Planis. Você e os outros Cavaleiros de Veda são os únicos que podem trazer a normalidade de volta ao mundo.

name: Edge Of Dead Prologue
desc: Um bullet hell que permite que você pegue e atire os móveis! Atire granadas e ative escudos, atrapalhe os inimigos, atire e desvie do fogo inimigo e coloque fogo no chão. Compre uma espingarda na loja ou prove um burrito estragada!

name: Asgard's Fall: Origins
desc: Embarque em uma saga épica em Asgard's Fall, um roguelite de sobrevivência nórdico. Abra caminho por hordas de criaturas e faça os deuses sentirem sua ira implacável. Como sua saga se desdobrará?

name: Astrality
desc: After a training simulation gone wrong, a bounty hunter embarks on a journey to find treasures and adventure.

name: Anonymous Hacker Simulator: Prologue
desc: Coloque-se no lugar de um habilidoso hacker anônimo e embarque em uma missão para revelar a verdade escondida por trás dos planos sinistros de uma organização para monitorar dados civis e impor uma vigilância em massa.

name: Mannequin
desc: Play as a clothing store worker who is just finishing up her shift and preparing to go home. However, as you make your way towards the exit, the power suddenly goes out, leaving you trapped inside the store.

name: Elewar: Fused Survivors
desc: Use your elemental powers to defeat terrifying monsters, while slowly becoming a godlike magician. Packed with challenging events, deep ARPG-like systems and a hardcore difficulty! 18+ classes, 25+ spells, 300+ unlocks, 140+ upgrades, over 50 random events and much more!

name: Guerra Sangrenta
desc: "Guerra Sangrenta" adota um mecanismo de otimização independente. Há várias formas de jogar, como competição clássica, de entretenimento e modo aventura. Equipamentos autênticos, experiência intensa de tiro, cenas de batalha emocionantes, tudo para permitir a diversão de batalhar com armas.

name: Asurya's Embers
desc: Asurya’s Embers is a 1st-person, single-player, bow-and-arrow shooter set in an ancient Himalayan village plagued by an environmental disaster. Find safety in the shadows from the blazing heat waves as Dawa, a bow-wielding hero who protects her village from the vengeful sun god, Asurya.

name: Kneedle Knight
desc: [I]Kneedle Knight[/I] is a 3rd-person puzzle platformer game. Conjure fabric with a magic needle as Sir Lukoss the Small and merge in and out of fabric. Solve puzzles, platform across magical objects, and defeat cursed candle minions to return Sir Lukoss to normal and defeat the Witch of Fabric!

name: Labyrinth of Rage
desc: Enter the Labyrinth... at your own demise.

name: SLUDGE LIFE: The BIG MUD Sessions
desc: Munch down a bite-sized SLUDGE LIFE experience in this free self-contained interlude.

name: 箭箭剑 Arrow a Row
desc: Arrow a row is a game in which you shoot arrows (of course) in a row! or maybe two rows! (maybe three?) Choose your power-ups and defeat the Boss.

name: Tatari: The Arrival
desc: Assuma o papel de um detetive de Tóquio que tenta resolver o misterioso caso do desaparecimento de um jovem campista. Você tentará seguir a trilha de evidências para guiá-lo através de um caso enigmático e paranormal relacionado a uma lenda urbana japonesa. Você pode ajudar até o fim?

name: Viking Hiking
desc:
Viking Hiking is a cheerful 3D Platformer. Join Bøf on his adventure to reach Valhalla. Jump, dash and use the horn as you explore a lush but challenging island!

Viking Hiking is a FREE game made by second year students from Breda University.

name: Summum Aeterna: Prologue
desc: Summum Aeterna is a fast-paced Roguelite set in the Aeterna Universe. Try its free version and create extraordinary adventures thanks to a unique world generator system called the "seed mechanic". Tons of enemies, weapons, mods, and upgrades... Every new run is different from the last!

name: Wolvesville
desc: Wolvesville is a multiplayer game for up to 16 players. Each game has different teams such as villagers or werewolves all fighting to be the last team standing. Use special abilities to uncover the roles of other players and convince your fellow players to work with you.

name: Coast Defender
desc: Mergulhe no mundo eletrizante das batalhas de alto risco. Lidere seu exército contra uma onda implacável de maquinários inimigos, desde os icônicos tanques da Segunda Guerra Mundial até os helicópteros modernos.

name: Plant Therapy
desc:
Get cozy in this plant collecting and decorating game!

Build a beautiful indoor garden from the ground up in your New York City apartment.

name: The Karters 2: Turbo Charged - Prologue
desc: Prepare-se para a adrenalina das corridas de The Karters 2: turbo charged! Combinando a jogabilidade de Mario Kart e Crash Team Racing junto a diversos novos modos de jogo para ter uma experiência inesquecível e cheia de emocional!

name: Cecelia
desc: A mysterious island. A giant baby made of stone awakens. Learn to trust each other if you want to explore the perilous terrain, seeking answers from the island's enigmatic call and an ominous force awaiting you in the distant lighthouse.

name: Pixel Royale 3D
desc: FPS pixelado cheio de ação! Corra, deslize e salte pelas paredes no campo de batalha! Jogue Mata-mata em Equipe, Mata-mata, Duelos ou Pixel Royale, onde o último sobrevivente vence! Dispute os rankings para ganhar itens exclusivos e chegar ao topo do mundo! Sem pay-to-win. Nunca.

name: Monday Meltdown
desc: Rápido. Sangrento. Caos para 8 Jogadores. Domine. Provoque. Repita. Grátis. Sem pegadinhas. Para sempre.

name: BOOMEROAD
desc:
BOOMEROAD is an exhilarating action-adventure game in which players slide along boomerang rails you will create.
The game is set in an ancient ruin floating in the sky, and the player slides through the vast skies at their own will while searching for the Artifacts.

name: NOTTOLOT
desc: NOTTOLOT is a free play robot hacking action game. The main character, Rolly, uses his "hacking ability" to control four enemies and escape from a robot production factory!

name: DoronkoWanko
desc:
『DORONKO WANKO』 is a DORONKO Action Game.
In this game, You can become a cute, innocent Pomeranian, make your master's home messy and dirty.

"Will the master be angry with me?"
Don't worry. Because you are a sweet doggie.

name: BYLE
desc: Fight through a corrupted city, battling over 50 unique enemies and powerful bosses. Arm yourself with an arsenal of weapons and uncover mysterious power-ups as you strive to liberate the city from the clutches of the mind-altering BYLE.

name: The Last Flame: Prologue
desc: Recrute heróis especiais, enfrente encontros mortíferos, colete e crie equipamentos poderosos, descubra e crie builds com sinergias únicas! The Last Flame é um auto-battler roguelike no qual você irá liderar seu grupo de heróis justiceiros através de muitos desafios.

name: Toy Shire: Room One
desc: Você está preparado para uma aventura de defesa de torres emocionantes com exércitos de brinquedos? Bem-vindo ao Toy Shire! Lute contra inimigos diversos em vários locais, defenda sua família, e espante os inimigos da sua área. Salve o mundo fortalecendo sua defesa com torres de brinquedo!

name: Resonite
desc: Enter a novel digital universe with infinite possibilities. Whether you resonate with people around the world in a casual conversation, playing games and socializing or you riff off each other when creating anything from art to programming complex games, you'll find your place here.

name: Powers in the Basement
desc: Uma curta aventura gráfica point-and-click ambientado em um mundo cômico de fantasia medieval, lembrando os grandes clássicos dos anos 80/90, com especial tributo às produções da LucasArts.

name: The Light in the Darkness
desc: The Light in the Darkness tells the story of a working-class family of Polish Jews in France during the Holocaust. It is the first videogame to portray the Holocaust, releasing free for educational purposes.

name: Embers: Return to Dragonland
desc: Save your legacy from the goblins by embodying legendary dragons in this cooperative twin-stick shooter action.

name: Akatori: Сhapter One
desc: Junte-se à jovem Mako enquanto ela se aventura em um mundo selvagem de exploração e encontra um misterioso companheiro pássaro. Navegue por dois reinos distintos com seu bastão e enfrente um sentinela ancião neste prólogo para o metroidvania repleto de ação, Akatori.

name: Pixel Gun 3D: PC Edition
desc: Pixel Gun 3D, o lendário FPS multijogador para dispositivos móveis, chega ao PC! Experimente um mundo aprimorado cheio de ação colorida em blocos. Apresentando dezenas de modos de jogo e mapas, mais de 1.500 armas, além de modo multijogador e progressão em várias plataformas.

name: Extremely Powerful Capybaras: Training Grounds
desc: Training Grounds é… isso mesmo, a versão prólogo do Extremely Powerful Capybaras! Se você se divertiu online sendo o bullet-hell com seus capi-migos, não deixe de visitar a página do Extremely Powerful Capybaras e adicionar o jogo completo na sua lista de desejos!

name: Platform Gun
desc: A sci-fi puzzle platformer using the platform gun

name: Darkless
desc: Nameless encarna um fantasma travesso que após uma terrível maldição foi colocada sobre ele, trancando-o em uma lâmpada. Será seu propósito recuperar seu corpo fantasmagórico viajando por todos os cantos da Mansão Silenciosa em um jogo de plataforma e quebra-cabeça onde a luz será crucial.

name: URBO: Dream One
desc: URBO: Dream One is a meditative puzzle game where you build houses around the mysterious Tower. Let your mind wander through visions of an enchanted city on an island in the middle of the crystal clear waters of a vibrant lake.

name: Dropkick Navvy: First Step
desc: Dropkick Navvy: First Step is a physics-based crafting/survival sim. Help the World Tree rebuild the broken cosmos as the responsibility falls upon you. Scurry through diverse landscapes, gather essential resources, and build your way towards finding the eternal source of water for the World Tree.

name: SCP: Nemesi
desc: SCP: Nemesi is a multiplayer survival-horror game where one player takes on the role of the SCP (anomalous creatures, each with its own abilities and appearance), and the other four players play as Humans, each with their own personal goals and tasks that may branch into different paths.

name: Heart and Core
desc: A twin-stick action brawler. Young engineer JJ and her robot companion, KAI, evade the totalitarian control of the ruthless Santiago. Traverse, hide, and fight your way through a seemingly unending onslaught of enemy RAMs. Use JJ’s Gravity Gun and KAI’s fists to stun and destroy enemies.

name: Mayhem Survivors: Animals
desc: Mayhem Survivors is an action rogue-like game, where you feed cute animals with various different foods in order to Survive. It is inspired by Survivors-like games and features 3 different game modes.

name: Crime Scene Cleaner: Prologue
desc: Quando há uma chamada, você é o homem para limpar após o serviço sujo do seu cliente. Ficar do lado da máfia é um jogo perigoso, mas eles pagam bem, e você precisa de dinheiro, certo? Então pegue seu esfregão e é melhor remover aquelas manchas de sangue rapidamente antes que a polícia chegue.
Each time you press the button, it will either double or lose all the points you’ve put in. How much will you risk?

name: Dreamland
desc: Gather your friends, discover new experiences, and make every moment unforgettable!

name: ClosingShift
desc: As you were closing for the night, you see a creature in the distance approaching. Fight for you life using the limited resources inside your grocery store.

name: Office Fight
desc: ‘Office Fight - Beta’ was an early access demo for Office Fight, a casual physics based destruction game. Full release page is here:

name: Mad King: Prologue
desc: Collect heroes in this mysterious land, and try your hand in the fast-paced PvP card battles! Utilize unique hero skills to strategize your hand and win the fights!

name: One-armed robber
desc: One-armed robber is a chaotic first-person heist game that centers around a uniquely challenging premise. Players take the role of a determined robber equipped with only one arm, tasked with pulling off daring heists on banks, shops, and various establishments.

name: Birds Aren't Real: The Game
desc: Birds Aren’t Real is a 3D sandbox game with a comic twist.Based on the real-life satirical conspiracy theory, play as a government surveillance pigeon drone, using sneaky maneuvers and creative thinking to manipulate the citizens and dispel their suspicions about the government's avian task force.

name: Conquistadorio: Prologue
desc: O conquistador, que enfrentou muitas provações em sua vida, decidiu se aposentar e se tornar um eremita. Apenas deitando em sua caverna solitária longe das pessoas. Mas parece que o próprio destino lhe lança novos desafios mesmo em assuntos tão simples.

name: Beacon Patrol: First Horizons
desc: Beacon Patrol: First Horizons é um jogo de estratégia relaxante com infinitas possibilidades. Dirija seu navio da Guarda Costeira e construa seu próprio mapa costeiro, uma peça de cada vez. Obtenha mais peças explorando e continue construindo indefinidamente.

name: Minute
desc: A 3D action platformer where you play as a wind-up toy in a Tinkerer's workshop set in the Victorian Age. As a small wind-up toy, you must rely on your wind-up key to embark on an arduous journey.  Defeat enemies and uncover a dark secret within the rooms.

name: Go Go Zombies
desc: Sweet raging fast zombie revenge!

name: The Local
desc: A fast-paced movement game, loosely inspired by Surf and B-Hop. Featuring 5 gamemodes, multiplayer, and a large, playground-like world. Master the movement, and conquer the leaderboards.

name: CD2: Trap Master - Prologue
desc: Um jogo legal que mistura defesa de torre 3D e construção de deck no estilo roguelike! Monte seu deck, configure armadilhas e detenha os vilões antes de enfrentar o grande chefe! Use várias armadilhas divertidas e simples para vencer seus inimigos!

name: Frontline 1942: Batalhas da Guerra Mundial 2
desc: Mergulhe nos tempos da Segunda Guerra Mundial e torne-se um verdadeiro herói! Atire, capture, vença – o caminho para a glória é pavimentado com conchas!

name: The Hardest Game Ever
desc: An insanely difficult precision platformer

name: Monster Crawl: Warrior
desc: FREE version of Monster Crawl featuring the Warrior & first few hours of gameplay || Horde based roguelike; slaughter them all with overpowering attacks & annihilate entire rooms. Explore diverse builds using heroes, abilities, buffs & relics. Beat Bosses to unlock Uber Relics. 2 player local co-op.

name: SoulofWar:Legions
desc: "SoulofWar" é um jogo de estratégia de construção de deck com reviravoltas. Possui batalhas PvP para 8 jogadores onde você supera estrategicamente seus oponentes. Ele apresenta uma nova jogabilidade de xadrez automático.

name: Future Breach: Youngblood
desc: Future Breach: Youngblood is a prologue chapter of the main game, Future Breach 3D. Breach and Clear areas tactically in a team-based shooter.

name: We're Tethered Together
desc: Cast into an ancient crypt, survive the horrors that dwell below, and ascend from despair with your unexpected companion in this short 2D puzzle platformer. Take risks to evade the petrifying gaze from beyond the dark.

name: SCP: Rulebreaker
desc:
After the opening of Site Samekh, only Sites 15 and 19 remain active. Complex Samekh was the most secure, but a new director hastened its downfall. As a guard, surviving the madness of anomalies is vital.
Survive and find the way out.

name: Virtuar Z
desc: Virtuar Z is a sci-fi third-person shooter game set in the future in a city full of conflict. Experience adrenaline-pumping laser combat from a third-person perspective that gives players a wider field of view, allowing for better situational awareness & strategic maneuvers.

name: Shell Runner - Prelude
desc: Shell Runner - Prelude is a PvE Extraction Top-Down Looter-Shooter set in a cyberpunk dystopian future. As a mercenary your objective is as clear as it's dangerous: infiltrate, assassinate, loot, and extract without dying. Or fail, and lose everything.

name: Potato Arena: Multiplayer Prologue
desc: Smash! Smack! Kick! Blow up! Burn! Beat! Boil! potatoes. Potato Arena is a 1-4 player local and online multiplayer party game. Fight and Compete as your own custom potatoes to win several different minigames against your 3 friends. Play football, Fish Slap, Sumo wrestle. Fight your friends!

name: Soul's Spectrum: Awakening
desc: Você acorda em uma masmorra misteriosa, cheia de armadilhas perigosas e habitantes azarados. Quebra-cabeças de quebrar o cérebro o aguardam, enquanto uma história sombria se desenrola lentamente nesse lugar sobrenatural!

name: Tank Team
desc: A team based PVP game where groups of up to 8 players must work together to operate a tank!

name: Survive It: Frozen
desc: Can you lead four different survivors despite threats in a hostile winter area? Join the strategic multiplayer challenge! Survive It: Frozen is a small indie game that comes with a new and unique gameplay concept combining survival and real time strategy.

name: The Windows Are Gone
desc: Assombrado pela dor e pela culpa após um trágico acidente, você começa a ver uma casa em seus sonhos. Não importa o que você faça, você não consegue tirar sua imagem da sua mente. Você sente que ela está chamando por você, então você a atende.

name: Taora : Beginning
desc: Taora : Beginning offers the limited introduction experience to Taora : Survival, an open world survival game with unique character building and crafting. Build and upgrade your base, and survive the zombie apocalypse!

name: Signal
desc: Signal is a third-person adventure game full of unknowns and dangers, where the player takes on the role of a father searching for his daughter, facing extreme life and death decisions, the player must rise to the challenge of finding clues and solving puzzles in order to have a chance of survival.

name: Stronghold Siege
desc: Command your army against a relentless demon horde in this intense real-time strategy game. Master strategy and resource management to conquer the enemy's stronghold while defending your own in the ultimate battle for survival.

name: Project Adder
desc: Project Adder is a run-and-gun, zombie-killing, rogue-lite sandbox game with dynamic gameplay that offers a unique experience in every play-through.

name: Oh Baby Kart
desc: Enfrente o mundo no Race Royale, encare o Gauntlet atrás de cartas roguelike e de um rival, crie suas próprias pistas e compartilhe na Oficina, e deixe o seu chat da Twitch apagar a sua tela e bombardear seus amigos.

name: Rock Star Life Simulator: Prologue
desc: Comece sua aventura tocando guitarra na rua! Conheça novas pessoas, descubra seus hobbies e envolva-se em conversas para impressioná-las! Você pode fazer diversos trabalhos para ganhar dinheiro, mas não esqueça que seu objetivo é se tornar uma estrela do rock!

name: What's on Agenda
desc: Um breve e relaxante clicker social onde você molda a narrativa da recém-formada Federação SARO. Siga Jan Eteri, um advogado proeminente, e veja como a propaganda muda a percepção da sociedade.

name: Shell's Kitchen
desc: Dive into a fintastic culinary adventure where fish serve fish dishes to fishes, and scale new heights of seafood fun with your friends in this cooperative cooking game!

name: Vivaland: Dream House
desc: Dream House é o modo de construção de Vivaland, no qual você pode criar a casa dos seus sonhos do zero. Jogue sozinho ou com amigos no modo cooperativo.

name: A Park Full of Cats
desc: Bem-vindo ao nosso Parque de Diversões! Prepare-se para um dia perfeito em 'A Park Full of Cats'. Explore, brinque e descubra inúmeros felinos adoráveis no meio dos brinquedos e atrações. Sua próxima aventura está esperando por você!

name: Retro Combat
desc: Casual FPS, no microtransactions. Play online or with bots with machine guns, tanks, and planes.

name: Cureocity
desc: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key."The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.

name: Drift.Wav
desc: Drift.Wav is a casual drifting game with a synthwave inspired aesthetic. This game is not meant to replicate / simulate actual drift mechanics, but more serve as a fun & relaxing game where you can slide in a synthwave inspired world. See if you can drift your way to the top of the leaderboard!

name: Mossy Pixels
desc: Destroy the mossy cover to reveal ancient drawings underneath! Watch the mysterious patterns get dissolved pixel-by-pixel and just... relax. :)

name: Astral Party
desc: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.

name: Vivaldia 2
desc:
Enfrentando inimigos robóticos implacáveis e navegando por selvas densas e perigosas, campos de lava escaldantes e pântanos traiçoeiros, Vivaldia mais uma vez parece enfrentar um desafio impossível.  

Com o destino da terra nas suas mãos – estará Vivaldia à altura da situação?

name: Sins OV Cigar
desc: Brutal Slice-Em-Up Gun and Scythe combat set in a deranged world. Playtime is an hour long, the game is a college project. Also known as Sins Of Cigar.

name: Aviators
desc: An educational adventure game about Polish air personnel during World War II. Meet the pilots of the 1586 Special Destiny Squadron and join them on incredible assignments. Explore and solve puzzles to learn more about the history of Polish aviation.

name: BladeBound
desc: Embark on an epic quest in Swords of Blood, a free-to-play RPG. Master elemental powers, craft legendary gear, and battle formidable foes in the realm of Ezura. Join the adventure today!

name: Cat Search In The Wild West
desc: 105 gatos estão escondidos nesta antiga cidade ocidental! Você consegue encontrar todos eles? Sente-se, relaxe e explore esta cidade ocidental desenhada à mão.

name: Dumball Rush
desc: Dumball Rush is an online racing party game from 2 to 8 players with a 3D third person view. The player controls a snowball that is racing against other players. Roll in the snow to be bigger and faster! Avoid obstacles and activate gifts to take advantage and win the race!

name: Champion Shift: Prologue
desc: Experience the daring escape of Champions from the clutches of the Dominion in this fast paced, thrilling online co-op Action Roguelike. Shift form into powerful vehicles, unleash Celestial powers and battle endless hordes of challenging enemies. The path to become a legend awaits you!

name: Groove that Goob
