desc: Abduct the Milky Way’s Oracle Jukebox located at the top floor of a penthouse party as the shapeshifting, absorbent Goob, fully equipped with a ravenous appetite for melodies, mankind, and mosh pits.

name: Catch Them Sweetie
desc:
Bem-vindo ao simulador de pesca com cartas!
É hora de limpar a lagoa de monstros. Escolha um alvo, monte o Deck e tente a sorte!
Ah, e não toque no pato, ok?

name: Raiders of Valhalla - Prologue
desc: Raiders of Valhalla: Prologue é uma demo gratuita de Raiders of Valhalla. Nesta prévia, lidere uma corajosa horda de anões vikings que lutam por Valhalla. Cumpra a missão dada pelos deuses. Prepare-se para batalhas épicas e experimente a ação e estratégia que aguardam no jogo completo!

name: Cycle Idle RPG
desc: An RPG where your character is constantly grinding - even when you're offline!

name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword
desc: Um samurai que empunha uma Manopla Oni se posiciona contra a ameaça dos Genma invasores em Quioto. Através de batalhas árduas e sangrentas, ele busca sua razão para lutar. Qual destino o aguarda no final do seu caminho?

name: Fairytale Fables
desc: Dive into a fantastical autobattler where fairytales and legends collide! Choose your hero and assemble your team of characters, items and treasures to outwit opponents in strategic battles where positioning matters. Will you be the last one standing in this enchanted PvP arena?

name: Snow Plowing Simulator - First Snow
desc: ❄️Simulador de remoção de neve - Primeira neve🎅 convida você para uma experiência imersiva de inverno! Comande uma frota de poderosos limpa-neves, enfrentando paisagens nevadas realistas. Este jogo de simulação de aventura gratuito desafia suas habilidades de arar.

name: Rumble Club
desc: Dê um soco em seus amigos de graça! Lute sozinho ou em equipe em um caos desajeitado em uma série de modos de jogo em constante mudança com até 20 jogadores.

name: Arsenal Online
desc: High-octane 2D shooter. Put your shooting skills to the test with over 200 weapons and attachments. Play game modes solo or co-op online!

name: Nonogram Nights
desc: Nonogram Nights is a spooky puzzler where you use logic to uncover a mysterious picture.

name: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator
desc: Niwa - Japanese Garden Simulator is a gardening simulator that gives you the freedom to design your own zen gardens. Set in Kyoto, Japan, you are tasked with learning authentic Japanese gardening techniques and applying them to realistic reproductions of historical locations in the city.

name: Betrayal Beach
desc: Crashed on a strange island, survivors must forage, craft, and complete objectives to stay alive. But ferocious beasts, harsh weather, and secret saboteurs seek to make sure they never escape. Betray your friends or survive the island in Betrayal Beach, a 4-8 player social deduction survival game.

name: Kerker
desc: Kerker is a procedurally generated dungeon crawler FPS roguelike that challenges the player with its varying cast of enemies, exclusive weapons and different dungeon types. Fight your way to riches by slaying foes, obtaining/combining unique abilities and finding forgotten treasures.

name: Steamrush
desc: STEAMRUSH is a third-person Boss Rush game featuring fast-paced melee combat against unique bosses, punctuated by exploration segments that gradually unveil the captivating story of the isolated city-state of Haze.

name: Star Stuff: Prologue
desc: An introduction to the world of Star Stuff, an upcoming puzzle game with a cosmic mix of automation and strategic action! Program bots to help you solve hand-crafted, purposefully designed challenges!

name: Intravenous 2: Mercenarism
desc: Você é Gideon, um mercenário impiedoso disposto a matar por dinheiro sem qualquer princípio moral, e terá liberdade tática com diversas armas e dispositivos especiais para cumprir sua missão no prólogo de Intravenous 2.

name: Grappling Gunners: Arena FPS
desc: Grappling Gunners is a free multiplayer FPS with two grappling shots for high-speed gunfights and full freedom of movement. Utilize seven skills, including teleportation and bullet time.

name: Mizi NO!
desc: Nesse jogo de quebra-cabeça 2D gratuito, você deve reconstruir os objetos quebrados que o seu gato derrubou.

name: Spellcats: Auto Card Tactics - Prologue
desc: Summon elemental kitties in this roguelike card game! You have been summoned to participate in a nekocaster tournament! Navigate through mysterious dungeons, build card combos, and unravel the story behind spellcats!

name: Blood Orange
desc:
Underwater psychological horror with a shocking, character-driven narrative.
Explore ruins beneath the amazon river basin, and converse with their dolphin inhabitants.
Skillfully capture and develop photographs with your underwater camera.

name: Knytt Classic
desc: Celebrate the 20th anniversary of the indie freeware classic, rebuilt for modern machines! Explore a maze-like planet as the Knytt, a peaceful being abducted by aliens, find your missing ship parts, and get back home in this zen-like atmospheric platformer.

name: One Week With The Mafia
desc: After a misuse of your home address, and the general incompetence of an old friend, you find yourself stuck with the Italian mafia hunting you down. In this parody of Scott Cawthon's "Five Nights at Freddy's", it is up to you to stop the mafia from wasting you.

name: SCP: Bloodwater
desc: SCP Bloodwater is a strategy management defense game inspired by the SCP Foundation's SCP-354, also known as the Red Pool. Take the role of a newly appointed Site Director at the Red Pool Containment Zone, harvest valuable organic material, and defend the facility against the Red Pool's attacks.

name: Tinkerlands: A Shipwrecked Adventure
desc: Tinkerlands: A Shipwrecked Adventure é a entrada para o mundo de Tinkerlands. Desvende a história dos primeiros sobreviventes, explore o arquipélago, crie ferramentas, monte sua aldeia e sobreviva!

name: Hypersomnia
desc: Challenge your friend to an intense duel, or gather two clans to fight a spectacular war. Reawaken your competitive spirit in this relentless top-down shooter. Comes with an in-game map Editor! Forever free and open-source.

name: The Braves: Beginning
desc: Dizime hordas de inimigos e sobreviva! Desbloqueie personagens diferentes, faça combinações de habilidades poderosas e embarque em uma empolgante jornada pelos mundos desse jogo roguelike fofo, mas impiedoso.

name: Goober Dash
desc: Goober Dash: A 2D platformer battle royale where Goobers Run, Jump & Dash to victory! Customize your Goober, dash to outmaneuver opponents, create your own levels, and compete in global time trials. Unlock exclusive skins and celebrate your wins in this action-packed multiplayer Race Royale!

name: RC Revolution: High Voltage
desc: Dive into RC Revolution High Voltage, the exhilarating free version of RC Revolution. Select from three dynamic cars, unlock a fourth, and challenge our AI for a fifth. Customize for style and performance, and get ready for stunt-filled tracks and nitro-fueled speed craze.

name: Astra Ignota
desc:
A relaxing, space-themed puzzle game where you fill a board using symmetrical figures, while uncovering a mysterious sci-fi story.
All boards are hand-crafted for maximum enjoyment.

name: TEST TEST TEST
desc: Escape a time loop as an overworked office employee by solving cryptic puzzles with alternate reality game elements.

name: 100 Asian Cats
desc: 100 Asian Cats - Participe da aventura mais fofa da Ásia! Explore a encantadora arte desenhada à mão dos templos asiáticos enquanto embarca em uma missão para encontrar 100 adoráveis gatos escondidos pelo jogo. Você consegue encontrar todos eles?

name: SNOWBREAK
desc: The new 3D Waifu Sci-Fi RPG Shooter is here! Aim at fate, fight by our side! Clear the specified stage to claim an Orange-Tier Operative!

name: Cats on Duty: Prologue
desc: Cats on Duty: Prologue é a miastura perfeita de RTS, match-3 e defesa de torres. Cuide de dois campos de jogo, equipe e aprimore suas torres felinas para derrotar hordas inimigas. Aproveite a batalha gatástica!

name: Psych//Shift
desc: PsychShift is a unique take on the fast and frenetic First-Person Shooter/Parkour formula. With one core mechanic at its center, the ability to instantaneously swap minds with nearly any enemy you choose. Taking on both their current position and also their characteristics.

name: Red Dead Redemption
desc: Conheça a história do ex-fora da lei John Marston e sua jornada para encontrar os últimos membros restantes da notória gangue Van der Linde na estreia para PC do aclamado predecessor de Red Dead Redemption 2.

name: Chambers: The Outlaw
desc: Explore o mundo aberto, conquiste terras enormes, envolva-se em duelos épicos e negocie em cidades agitadas nesse conjunto de ação e aventura! Chambers: The Outlaw é uma versão prévia do jogo Chambers.

name: Medieval Machines Builder - First Siege
desc: Embark on a captivating journey back to the roots of medieval conflict with Medieval Machines Builder - First Siege. This free-to-play simulation game offers a taste of the grandeur and challenges that await in the full game. Design, build, and destroy. Medieval lethal weapons await you!

name: Dreamslayer
desc: Dreamslayer is an epic fantasy first-person hack’n’zap swarm arena game with retro styling. Defend your world from a Demon invasion from beyond the stars.

name: Bloodshots
desc: Immerse yourself in a terrifying survival horror experience set in a laboratory where horrific experiments have been conducted. Take on the role of Joseph Alexander Blackwell, who has to rescue his daughter. To succeed, you will be forced to use your own blood in unusual and twisted ways.

name: Free Chess
desc: Free Chess is a free physics based chess simulator where you are free to play the game of chess with the freedom of however you like.

name: Moi Moi Heroes
desc: Moi Moi Heroes offers a wacky adventure on Moi Moi Island! Reach King Moi Moi's crown and return it to score. Become the ultimate "Moi Moi Hero" in this uproarious adventure!

name: Jinni : Haunted House
desc: Can you escape this haunted house? Or will you become a hostage of the mysterious creatures? It's up to you! Find your way out of the haunted house and save your life!

name: LASERS
desc: LASERS is a brutally hard multiplayer game about surviving deadly laser mazes. Only one player can win. Will it be you?

name: Basketball Grand Slam 2024
desc: "Basketball Grand Slam 2024" is a real-time basketball competitive game. The game uses real-time synchronization technology to ensure fair competition among players. Smooth operation, smooth touch, and real dynamic capture system create a 3D basketball world. Welcome to your Basketball world!

name: 失落的猫猫 Lost Cat
desc: "Lost Cat" is a single-player, adorable, healing, adventure game. Try to collect enough fish while avoiding traps and monsters, and use your wits to clear the levels.

name: Echolight
desc: Echolight ist ein actionbasiertes Roguelike-Spiel, in welchem du die Welt vor dem Chaos gefährlicher Monster, mit Hilfe der Waffen der Götter  des Tages und der Nacht retten musst.

name: Age of Advent
desc: Welcome to the Age of Advent! Play four minigames based on the members of hololive -Advent-! Save the Moai with Bijou, make a soup with Nerissa, try not to crash with FUWAMOCO, and avoid the gaze of Shiori!

name: Octameta
desc: A 3D-styled puzzle-solving burning brain indie game, using the Pocket Cube to restore objects. A story about AI's journey to recreate the history of human science

name: Alpha League
desc: Alpha League é um Auto Chess gratuito baseado em heróis. Na Alpha League, basta escolher e construir seu herói favorito no estilo Roguelike com 12 gêneros de combate diferentes e depois lutar contra os outros 7 Bots ou Jogadores para ser o vencedor.

name: William and Sly: Classic Collection
desc: The world of William and Sly is yours to explore, seeking out collectables and secrets, while soaking in the tranquil visuals and melancholic soundtrack. In this pair of classic Flash games, you play as a fox, running and leaping through an atmospheric ecosystem entirely at your own pace.

name: Alchemy Frogs
desc: Alchemy Frogs is a local co-op puzzle platformer game with a 3D, isometric camera, in which Frog & Toad traverse a poisoned swamp to look for a cure that will help them save their family from being turned to stone. Frog & Toad will mix their potions to unleash powerful magical effects.

name: TRUFFLE
desc: TRUFFLE is a minimalist puzzle maze game where touching the walls kills you instantly. It is a high difficulty, patience testing, dexterity game.

name: Divergence
desc: Explore a mysterious island with the help of a time manipulation device. Rewind and diverge from your current timeline to combat the ancient guardians and discover the secrets behind Titans.

name: 垃圾桶军团
desc: The pioneers have been salivating at your trash can for a long time! They have formed a garbage can army and are preparing to launch an attack on your home! Reasonably use your characters to resist the repeated attacks of the Garbage Can Legion! Or...... Join the Garbage Can Legion!

name: Sonder
desc: Experience an innovative co-op adventure where two players have to work together. Engage in collaborative puzzle solving and dynamic combat with each player having unique abilities. Delve into a psychological narrative that explores the essence of humanity.

name: Path of Exile 2
desc: O Path of Exile 2 é um RPG de Ação da nova geração criado pela Grinding Gear Games. Ele se passa anos após o Path of Exile original, você retornará ao mundo de Wraeclast para tentar dar um fim à corrupção que está se espalhando.

name: PEPITA VIAJERA ARTIC
desc: Pepita Viajera travels and lands in the Arctic and needs to recover the pieces of her plane. Help her recover the pieces by properly answering the questions that will be asked and avoiding multiple obstacles in this educational platform game.

name: With Shining Eyes
desc: Uncover secrets, experience history, solve puzzles and understand one another. Immerse yourself and explore a surreal and colorful world in this short, first-person adventure.

name: Dream of the Star Haven
desc: A giant-leap 1st person platforming journey through islands in the sky! Recover your stolen body parts, gaining new powers for each part you find. Delve into the strange gilded-cage secrets of the conscious place known as Star Haven

name: Nothing
desc: A game about doing Nothing

name: ゆきうさ
desc: A game of bouncing snow rabbits!

name: Seasons of Rocco
desc: Help Rocco prepare for the winter season by gathering and sorting fruit at his Tree House in the autumn season. Plant new fruit trees in the spring season, to make sure Rocco has even more food next winter! A relaxing experience for cozy gamers who seek a delightful escape into the charming seasons.

name: my eyes deceive
desc: Set over the course of roughly a week, you play as a young girl who has been living in a shelter all her life. The outside world is infected with a deadly disease. Society is in chaos. Fortunately, your papa is protecting you.

name: Cursed Enigma - Priest and Prayers
desc: Father Giovanni, a devout priest, becomes entangled in mysteries and secrets while overseeing his local church. Explore the dark truths and menacing events behind the serene facade of the parish in the first episode of CURSED ENIGMA: Priest and Prayers

name: Mist
desc: Short atmospheric first person horror game with elements of quest and shooter about being lost in the middle of nowhere, surrounded by weird mist.

name: AC Sailing
desc: The official game of the America’s Cup e-Series. Experience the power of yacht racing in a world class sailing simulation! Take the helm of high-tech foiling AC40 yachts in fleets of up to 8 players, with this authentic pro sailing experience.

name: Atan
desc: Escale um colossal gigante neste jogo de ação e aventura de escalada. Encontre seu caminho através de cenários atmosféricos e domine suas habilidades de escalada. Atan é um jogo GRATUITO criado por estudantes do terceiro ano da Universidade de Breda.

name: Sicaria
desc: Antwerp 1576, Spanish Fury is putting the city to the sword. You intend to stop the atrocities by eliminating the menace.                         ​Sicaria is a FREE game made by third year students from Breda University.

name: Shred Off
desc: In this 3rd-person action, snowboarding shooter, perform Stylish tricks in the Alaskan mountains while gunning down enemies with an arsenal of ranged weaponry. Shred down the mountain on your snowboard to get a high score while competing against your friends!

name: Iron Line
desc: Iron Line is a tower defense game where you are one of a few, train conductors capable of traversing on the Iron Line. Will you survive the onslaught, or get an express ticket to the afterlife?

name: NIGHT-RUNNERS PROLOGUE
desc: Descend into the underworld of Japanese street racing. Set between 1990-2009, join the local street racing crews in their battle for territory control. Explore the real location open world(s), compete in wager races, battle other crews and upgrade your vehicles with detailed car customization.

name: Palia
desc: O Palia é um novo mundo, vibrante e perfeito para você. Crie, cozinhe, pesque e cultive com amigos enquanto leva a vidinha dos seus sonhos e descobre uma encantadora aventura repleta de personagens coloridos e um mistério para desvendar.

name: dWARf
desc: dWARf is a local pvp multiplayer game in which you can take on your friends in five small arenas presenting very different challenges. Become the new king of the dWARves and have fun!

name: Bam Boom Blade
desc: Bam Boom Blade is a physics-based 2D joust game for 2 players. Act as a wuxia riding on a bamboo, and try to defeat your rival using only 2 joysticks on your gamepad! Experience the original Chinese wuxia sword fight aesthetics in the bamboo grove.

name: Spark & Kling
desc: Spark & Kling is a couch co-op puzzle platformer where the player will take the role of either Spark, the electric bug, or Kling the metal gel blob. They are trapped in a Homemade lab by a Mad Scientist  and the players will have to overcome obstacles and work together to escape.

name: Mimic Search
desc: Mimic Search is a short indie horror game, in which you take the role of a police officer investigating a recent mimic attack.

name: Pocket Pusher
desc: A relaxing physics-simulation with satisfying visuals. Build piles of coins, then watch marbles smash into them. Collect tickets and redeem them for prizes. Admire those prizes and read fun* lore. *Lore not guaranteed to be entertaining in any way

name: Museum Mystery
desc: Museum Mystery is a deck-building, story-driven roguelite adventure where museum exhibits come to life, wreaking chaos. Explore halls from different eras, battle works of art, collect your own deck of artifacts, and solve the mystery!

name: Holo X Break
desc: Fight your way through endless waves of holoX's minions! Gear up with all sorts of equipment and items in this action packed beat-em-up to reach the 5 bosses of hololive's "holoX", and put a stop to their plans!

name: 化鬼Deteriorate上
desc: 《化鬼 Deteriorate》是一款动物主角题材的横版解谜恐怖游戏，你需要根据关卡提示解开谜题，并在追逐战中躲避反派的追杀，在【死亡交易】中存活下来。

name: Gloomsday
desc: Gloomsday is a dark roguelite action-platformer. Thief-turned-mage Gary entered Colwell Academy looking for loot. Now he must fight to escape. Draw mana from your surroundings to cast spells—keep moving or you’ll run out. To be still is to die, but in Colwell Academy, death is only the beginning.

name: CLeM: The First Attribute
desc: CLeM: The First Attribute é um prólogo gratuito que inclui o primeiro ciclo de CLeM, um jogo de aventura e enigmas focado em sua história insólita. Acorde num mundo de enigmas e exploração unidos para criar uma narrativa única enraizada na alquimia.

name: Notes To Myself
desc: The horror began when you wrote your first note.

name: Idle Fishing
desc: Relaxe e pesque em belos ambientes enquanto sua tripulação trabalha para você, mesmo offline. Contrate tripulantes, colete pets, navegue em barcos cada vez maiores e descubra camadas e mais camadas de progressão. Simples de começar, surpreendentemente profundo.

name: Charrua Soccer - Mirror Edition
desc:
Mirror Edition? Absolutamente! Mergulhe na ação e adrenalina que você conhece e ama da Pro Edition. 
Crie sua equipe, aprimore-a a cada partida e progrida até chegar à liga Elite!"

name: Kona & SnowRabbit: Pilot
desc:
Kona, an ice artist with a reputation for mischief, and Snowrabbit, a white-furred snow rabbit full of desire.
After hearing the story of Aquus, the mermaid goddess, the two down-on-their-luck artists break into the monastery of Aquus, nicknamed "the sea on land," to make a statue of a goddess.

name: Sluggerpunk
desc: Sluggerpunk is a gripping 2D survivors roguelike adventure. As you navigate through a myriad of challenges, hone your skills and strategies to clash with formidable foes lurking in the underground. Build a versatile arsenal of abilities and gear to enhance your chances to survive, but will you?

name: Satori
desc: Satori is a Hack & slash game made as a final Master Degree project. Immerse yourself in a world of samurai and mystical creatures in this Japanese Hack & Slash. Master deadly skills as you unleash mayhem and honour in epic battles.

name: Sputnika Game
desc: A Cosmic twist on a Suika-style game with space gravity. Help our little friend Sputnik on his journey to become the Sun.

name: Ghost Only
desc:
'Ghost Only' is a RTS game of ghost to resurrect ancient demon.
Let's defeat the disturbing heroes with the skulls and bring the ancient demon resurrect to create chaos in the world!

name: Rise of the Eternal
desc: Rise of the Eternal is a 2D-side scroller developed in Unreal Engine 5. It has beat'em up aspects and boss battles.

name: Gun vs. Zombies
desc: Gun vs. Zombies is a thrilling showdown where precision meets undead mayhem. Take control of a dynamic gun affected by physics as you fend off waves of zombies hungry for a brain feast. Compete against others on the global leaderboard by showcasing your shooting skills.

name: Cyber Rush
desc: Shoot your way through endless plagues of robots and use the game's advanced parkour and movement system to survive.  Purchase special weapons and character upgrades to get stronger and survive more rooms!

name: Frostrain
desc: Be the last train conductor roaming the postapocalyptic frozen world! Expand, strengthen, and build synergies on your train. The promised land beyond the toxic zone awaits you and your passengers.

name: Gravitia
desc: Gravitia é um jogo de aventura sobre como manipular a gravidade para escapar de um mundo único e cheio de mistérios.

name: Necro Rumble
desc:
Master the dark art of necromancy in a 2D top-down strategy game.

Unleash and lead your undead legions to defeat and dominate enemy waves in this action-packed adventure.

name: Legendary Hoplite: Arachne’s Trial
desc: Legendary Hoplite: Julgamento de Arachne é um jogo que combina Defesa de Torre e Ação RPG. Faça upgrade do seu exército, use o melhor equipamento, crie estratégias únicas em 10 níveis. Enfrente Arachne e avance rumo à vitória no jogo principal.

name: NOVA CORE CHAOS
desc: NOVA CORE CHAOS is a chaotic co-op cooking game for one to five players. Play as one of five unique classes and follow the recipes to make energy cores. Give these to your customers to help them evolve into Novas!

name: Mahjong Soul
desc: Mahjong Soul is an online game that adopted the classic Japanese Mahjong gameplay. Here, you can hone your mahjong skills with players from worldwide or spend leisure time with friends, bond with various charismatic characters, and experience an abundance of unique stories.

name: SHADOW
desc:
スクールカーストを題材としたストーリー。
学校内で起きた出来事を影で暗躍しながら解決していきます。

name: LISA: The First
desc: A memory of madness.

name: 100 Capitalist Cats
desc: 100 Capitalist Cats - Participe da aventura mais fofa de Wall Street! Explore a encantadora arte desenhada à mão de Nova York, o coração do capitalismo, enquanto você embarca em uma missão para encontrar 100 adoráveis gatos escondidos pelo jogo. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Você consegue encontrar todos eles? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

name: My Friend The Spider
desc: A small "horror" narrative game about isolation and depression.

name: TSEROF
desc: Find hidden puzzle pieces and find the secret of a Charlotte who lost her memory.

name: The Zhukov Line
desc: A short one-room-horror which takes place on a livestock train in a dystopian Soviet state

name: Detective Kiwi
desc: "Detective Kiwi" is a free to play multiplayer puzzle game that designed up to 6 players, featuring a simple rule: There will be 4 images every round. You need to find them as fast as you can.

name: iLLANG
desc: iLLANG is a free-to-play multiplayer social deduction game where players help the villagers of Koji Village find the sneaky Illang who has been wreaking havoc!

name: Swing Into Zero-G
desc: Fast-paced multiplayer racing game set in the vastness of space. Compete against friends or online rivals in intense races, where quick reflexes and strategic use of diverse skills determine the victor. Embrace the challenge of swinging your way to victory in this exhilarating space-themed race!

name: Nova Hearts: The Spark
desc: Junte-se a Luce e seus amigos neste PRIMEIRO capítulo GRATUITO: A Centelha! Uma força misteriosa transforma você e outros residentes de Vermillion em heróis e vilões. CONVERSE, NAMORE e LUTE nesta aventura de encontros com combate por turnos!

name: DarkStorm
desc: Play as MARS (Machine of Absolute Retaliation and Safeguard), a robot programmed to exterminate the treacherous aliens who have taken over Razor City. As MARS, you must free Razor City from its domination in order to save  the survivors from their doom.

name: Picker Bot 42
desc: Explore, discover items, find Wassie lore, upgrade PB42 to gloriously defeat mutant plants and fly back home

name: TAVUTI
desc: TAVUTI's adventure to regain the power of the Whale God and rescue the kidnapped COCOSI!

name: Meteora's Mystic Merge
desc: Meteora's Mystic Merge é um jogo de quebra-cabeça baseado no famoso jogo Suika, mas com habilidades adicionadas. Em vez de frutas, utiliza uma variedade de Vtubers como ativos. Combine dois personagens para chegar lentamente ao final.

name: Adapta Solva
desc: Adapta Solva is a short puzzle platformer adventure. Play as an Adaptarian to absorb elements from magical shrines to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles. Uncover the truth behind your creation in a world laid to ruin by an unknown cause.

name: Kudamono Party
desc:
Get ready for a fruit-fueled adventure! 
In this fast-paced puzzle game, launch and align fruits to rack up points and rise in the global ranks. With vivid graphics and engaging gameplay, it's a race against time to become the top fruit master. 

Dive in and challenge the world!

name: OBSCURIA
desc: After the largest cruise ship in the world suffered a shipwreck and was invaded by ghosts, you must find Captain Blackhood after he disappeared, enter the great Nocturne and investigate all the secrets and mysteries.

name: 我的小鲨鱼
desc: 来领养一只电子小鲨鱼吧！你可以在这里把它当作物品一样处置，并掌握它的一切。但请放心，无论发生了什么，电子小鲨鱼仍然爱你。

name: Devilish League
desc: Swing, hit, and bounce! Blast enemies with your heavy bat in this hilarious cartoon roguelike!

name: Ingression: The Portal Trial
desc: Ingression: The Portal Trial oferece um vislumbre do mundo imersivo das plataformas de precisão com portais. Explore o prólogo do jogo completo de graça, encarando os níveis iniciais para depois se aventurar por estágios mais desafiadores.

name: Aurora Hills: Capítulo 1
desc: Aurora Hills: Chapter 1 é a primeira parte de uma série de jogos de aventura com puzzles de apontar e clicar. Segue a viagem de Ethan Hill, um guarda-florestal encarregado de investigar estranhos desaparecimentos na região para desvendar o mistério de Aurora Hills!

name: Marvel Rivals
desc: Marvel Rivals é um jogo de tiro JxJ em equipe com Super Heróis! Reúna um grupo de estrelas da Marvel, crie estratégias e combine seus poderes para executar poderosas habilidades de equipe. Lute em cenários destrutíveis e campos de batalha dinâmicos pelo universo Marvel em constante evolução.

name: Psychopomp
desc:
Your entire life has been a lie.
There are catacombs under every home and building, stretching down for miles.
Something calls you deeper into the labyrinth.
Delve into the depths, and discover the monstrosities below.

name: Looking For Cats In a Badly Drawn City
desc: Explore the amazing corners of a city full of jagged lines and curved outlines. Your goal is to find 100 cats hidden in the most unexpected places!

name: Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
desc: Comece a administrar seu próprio supermercado com o Prologue já. Estoque, atue no caixa, processe pedidos online e expanda. Ajuste preços conforme o mercado. Lembre-se do empréstimo da máfia e das consequências de não pagar à noite.

name: SirKwitz
desc: Dive into SirKwitz: a beginner-friendly edutainment game that makes learning programming easy & fun! Explore 28 puzzles across four topics to master the very core concepts behind programming and develop your problem-solving skills. Ideal for those that think coding & programming are scary words!

name: 100 Ninja Cats
desc: 🐱🥋100 Ninja Cats - Participe da aventura mais fofa no tema Ninja 🗡️ locais cheios de gatos! Explore a arte desenhada à mão dos locais e dos gatos Ninja enquanto você embarca em uma missão para encontrar 100 gatos adoráveis escondidos pelo jogo. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Você consegue encontrar todos eles?🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

name: Hoversteppers: Zone 1
desc: Hoversteppers is a freestyle hoverboard skating game. Flip, spin, and test your boarding skills with timed challenges across multiple stages.

name: RC Overdrive
desc: Dive into the exciting world of remote-controlled car racing with RC Overdrive, where strategy, precision, and speed come together for an electrifying and thrilling experience!

name: Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue
desc: Administre sua própria pet shop em Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue! Encontre novos lares para os animais de estimação, realizando os sonhos de seus clientes. Cuide das necessidades dos animais vendendo os itens certos e envolvendo-se nos assuntos relacionados à vida doméstica dos pets!

name: BioGun: Clinical Trial
desc: Versão próloga do jogo BioGun. Mergulhe no mundo microscópico. Enfrente ameaças virais e corredores de vento na sua missão para salvar o melhor amigo da humanidade. Você será a vacina que salvará um tipo de cão da extinção?

name: Guano
desc: Play as a delightfully dumb seagull, find food and complete quests to help free the Grand Masters and gain their powers. Harrass humans and free the Pohemeda Islands from the evil Food Inc. with your powerful poop and loud screams!

name: Bolt'N'Punch
desc: Exploring a disarrayed food factory, play as Lyft and fight your way through this chaos using powerful abilities. Face off against relentless robots and bring them to pieces. There’s only one option left to stop them: destroy them, throw them, PUNCH 'EM!

name: Shrimp.io
desc: A Shrimp Based Bullet Heaven.  Kill creatures, Level up & pick from 3 upgrades to unalive thousands more.

name: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE DEMO
desc: Entre na briga em uma experiência intensa e rápida de tiro em primeira pessoa. Mate com armas, explosivos, drones e apoio aéreo. Domine mapas em partidas mortais, equipe e PVE. Vença tática ou brutalmente. Lembre-se: Cem mortes. Uma arena. Zero regras. Que vença o melhor jogador!

name: Tangles
desc: Awakening from a long coma following a training injury, Soldier Basel finds himself alone in an isolated camp on a deserted island surrounded by questions and mystery. He begins to search for answers to uncover the secrets, and whether they are painful truths or terrifying illusions.

name: IVRI
desc: IVRI is a space-station exploration game in which you navigate an eerie, abandoned space station, piecing together the puzzle of the missing crew and uncovering the secrets hidden within the ship's walls.

name: Kittenrock Cats - A Hidden Object Game
desc: Welcome to the enchanting  'Kittenrock Cats - A Hidden Object Game' resort! Uncover hidden kitties in a captivating mountain setting, complete with nature, cabins, and campgrounds. Delve into charming mini-stories and find surprises in a world that's playfully inviting!

name: Rama's Quest
desc: Rama's Quest is an action survival game rooted in Hindu mythology. Invoke divine powers from the gods in your custom builds as you face waves of Rakshasa demons.

name: Genopanic: Prologue
desc: Entre em Genopanic: Prólogo, o início de uma experiência dinâmica (NÃO) metroidvania! Maneje um cortador de plasma, faça parceria com seu cão virtual LAIK, supere a astuta IA gata VOLGA, descubra os segredos da Matéria Escura e explore experimentos de DNA em uma aventura galáctica.

name: Mini Settlers: Prologue
desc: Mini Settlers é um jogo de construção de cidades minimalista! Ocupe ilhas construa cidades e projete redes logísticas eficientes para atender às necessidades das suas construções impulsionar o crescimento populacional e poder se aventurar em novos mundos.

name: My Shadow
desc: Explore the enigmatic world of My Shadow, a 2.5D Horror Puzzle Platformer where reality blurs. As night descends, illusions materialize, luring you into the intricate depths of your own mind. Unravel the mysteries where the boundaries of reality haze and imagination takes control.

name: Escape from Ever After: Onboarding
desc: Um RPG inovador inspirado pelos clássicos Paper Mario! Comece uma jornada para batalhar contra a megacorporação Para Sempre S.A. enquanto ela assume o controle de livros para mão de obra barata! Escape from Ever After: Onboarding é uma versão prólogo do jogo Escape from Ever After.

name: Neon Nova
desc: Dive into the adrenaline-fueled world of Neon Nova, a cutting-edge Neon Arena Ship Shooter! Experience intense arena battles, unlock customizable ships with vibrant neon skins, and dominate diverse game modes. Are you ready to be the master of the neon universe? Jump in now!

name: Brighter Shores
desc: Brighter Shores is an all new adventure from award winning MMORPG designer Andrew Gower. It is an enchanting point-and-click style RPG with hundreds of hours of gameplay, set in a land of magic and mysteries, with a huge number of professions to try, and something new to find around every corner.

name: Moss Piglets
desc: This real-time strategy game requires you to direct your horde of moss piglets through dynamic terrains and great dangers.

name: FELLCHASER
desc: You've stolen Death’s scythe in an attempt to cheat your fate. Now you must escape Purgatory by brewing combo-building potions and reaping hordes of creatures in this hack and slash Roguelike!

name: All City King
desc: All City King is a stealth game where you take the role of an up-and-coming street artist. Your target is the subway trains and your goal is to make your art travel all over the city.

name: Atuel
desc: Atuel é um jogo e documentário surrealista onde você vai explorar paisagens oníricas inspiradas na topografia do Vale do Rio Atuel, na Argentina.

name: The WereCleaner
desc: Kyle is a Janitor. He's also a Werewolf. And now he's got the night shift. Try not to kill anyone while working to get your paycheck - in a stealth-comedy game with surprises around every corner.

name: Illusion Carnival
desc: Uma alma perdida vagueia por uma encantadora e sinistra diversão estilo livro pop-up. Mergulhe em estágios repletos de diversão, encontre personagens únicos, defenda-se da erosão espiritual e descubra os segredos ocultos do parque. O encantador e sombrio Carnaval Ilusório começa agora.

name: Rental
desc: Rental is a short and spooky adventure game about the dangers of renting a house in an unknown place.

name: Introspection
desc: IntroSpection is a top-down bullethell-like action game about a man forced to confront his past. Delve into memories and blast through waves of inner demons as you explore one man's mental purgatory.

name: HYPER DEMON PVP
desc:
HYPER DEMON PVP is a free online 1v1 FPS.
Master simple but deep mechanics and defeat opponents in intense duels to climb the global leaderboard.

name: 100 Dino Cats
desc: 🦖🐾100 Dino Cats - Participe da aventura mais fofa nos locais temáticos de dinossauros 🦕🐈 cheios de gatos! Explore as obras de arte enquanto embarca em uma missão para encontrar 100 gatos adoráveis escondidos pelo jogo. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Você consegue encontrar todos eles? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

name: 100 Robo Cats
desc: 🤖🦾🐾100 Robo Cats - Participe da aventura mais fofa nos locais com tema de robô 🔩🦿 cheios de gatos! Explore a arte desenhada à mão dos locais dos Robôs e dos Gatos e tente encontrar 100 gatos adoráveis escondidos pelo jogo. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Você consegue encontrar todos eles? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

name: Folgore
desc: 1959 - Olimpia, South Italy. Play as Giove Scadenza and save your fiancée from the Inferna mafia with your newfound powers. Can you survive the Folgore ?

name: Space Hat
desc: Space Hat is an adrenaline-fueled, fast-paced FPS game that combines intense combat with well thought out platforming sequences. In this futuristic sci-fi world, the player assumes the role of a cyber bounty hunter equipped with a special hat that grants the power of teleportation.

name: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods
desc: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods is a free-to-play action-adventure game where you embark on a journey to slay a god. The very first game by Studio Castor, set in a medieval high fantasy open world.

name: Project Entropy
desc: Welcome, commander, to Project Entropy- an ultimate Sci-Fi and role-playing game with battles in space. In this immersive MMO experience, you will command alien civilizations, conquer uncharted planets, and build Hero fleets.

name: Cardboard Chronicles
desc: Welcome to Doodleburg! You play Doodle, a child who has been transported into a cardboard world of their own creation. Not all is well in the Burg of Doodle. An ancient, extradimensional evil has awoken and it's up to you to save this idyllic town from its ravenous rampage.

name: Battlefield™ 6
desc: A experiência da guerra total definitiva. Em uma guerra de tanques, jatos e enormes arsenais de combate, seu pelotão é a arma mais mortal.

name: Codename CURE II
desc: Codename CURE II é um FPS cooperativo ambientado após um apocalipse zumbi. Monte um esquadrão militar de elite com até cinco jogadores e enfrente hordas de zumbis em missões dinâmicas baseadas em objetivos.

name: Meta-Ghost: Prologue
desc: Immerse yourself in the reality show — "Breaking Show", where you engage in real-time battles with various intelligent machines using cybernetic enhancements and weapons. Whether for personal gain or lofty ideals. Fight! Until you reach the final victory on this Rogue-lite journey.

name: Deck of Delirium
desc: Deck of Delirium is a PvE deckbuilding card game where you build your own misfit crew full of animals, pirates, animal pirates, pompous sailors, and even cultists to make your way through the perilous journey across the sea battling rogue pirates, sea monsters, and other uncanny enemies.

name: Vigor
desc: Sobreviva ao apocalipse! Encare Embates intensos e resgate os espólios mais valiosos das Terras Distantes! Saqueie, atire e construa para se tornar um Forasteiro completo e explore o cenário da Noruega do pós-guerra em Vigor, um jogo grátis de tiro e coleta.

name: Joe 'n Jo
desc: Joe ‘n Jo is a challenging physics-based platformer about two giraffes who are strapped together for eternity. Play solo or with a friend and make your way through unique environments that will test your coordination and patience!

name: last seen online
desc: Look through someone else’s computer. Inspired by early “escape room” flash games.

name: Pogo Pogo
desc: I put together this game to upset a certain kind of individual.

name: FreeInfantry
desc: Isometric. Massively Multiplayer. Capture The Flag. Skirmish. Bug Hunt. And more. Welcome to FreeInfantry - the world's first massive multiplayer online isometric shooter.

name: Rabbit Hole
desc:
Rabbit Hole is a fast paced, tough-as-nails 2D RogueLike-Shooter, made with love for the genre.
You are Disc, someone who was suddenly brought to the Rabbit Hole. 
Collect guns, fight foes and meet strange new characters on your descent to the bottom, all in an attempt to find your heart again.

name: CastingPlz
desc: CastingPlz is a 2-player cooperative roguelike game where players take on the roles of two characters with distinct responsibilities: one for attacking and the other for movement.

name: On Track
desc: On Track is a cozy productivity tracker to help you rejuvenate, relax, and focus on tasks you want to accomplish. Watch a lush landscape roll by as you watch from your cozy train seat. Set a timer to focus, manage a todo list with all your goals, and relax as you stay on track.

name: Escape From Zombietown
desc: Escape From Zombietown is an Action Shooter FPS where you collect guns, grenades and consumables to help you fight off the zombies while you make your way out of town. With 20 levels filled to the brim with zombies, this game has all the zombie annihilating action you need.

name: Age of Water: The First Voyage
desc: Embark on your first adventure on a post-apocalyptic Earth completely covered in water. Sail through storms, fight and trade, capture other people's boats or build your own, extract resources from the bottom of the ocean, reveal the secrets of the Age of Water world.

name: 1000 Cuts: Jomaku
desc: A challenging 2D action platformer with brutal one-hit-kill combat, consequential choices, and a lore-rich story set in the dark fantasy world of Kurogawa, Japan. Inspired by Sekiro and Blasphemous, Jomaku is a free preview of One-Thousand Cuts, "raising the curtain" for the full game coming soon!

name: Meteor Havok
desc: Meteor Havok is a take on the classic Asteroids arcade shooter. Enter the asteroid fields to blast a path to safety with your agile ship and powerful lasers.

name: Bed and BEAKfast
desc: A DEMO of "Sincerely, Robin" -- our upcoming management, cooking, and narrative game currently in development! Play as Robin and return to your hometown to regrow your late grandfather's bed and breakfast. Cook meals, connect with the community, and forge lasting relationships!

name: 100 Istanbul Cats
desc: Participe da aventura mais fofa em Istambul 🕌, a Turquia cheia de gatos! Explore as encantadoras obras de arte dos locais temáticos de Istambul e tente encontrar 100 adoráveis gatos escondidos pelo jogo. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Você consegue encontrar todos eles? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

name: 驱煞
desc: QUSHA is a Chinese-style roguelike survivor game where you take on the role of a novice Daoist disciple in a world overrun by demons. As you progress through the game, you'll master a variety of talismans and Daoist techniques, unlocking powerful spells to combat evil forces and defend the peace.

name: Reborn: An Idle Roguelike RPG
desc: A tactical idle roguelike RPG where you progress through auto-battles, gather resources, craft gear, and brew stat-boosting potions. Build your character, shape a village of evolving NPCs, and uncover hidden truths in a story-driven world that rewards curiosity and time.

name: Soulbind: Prologue
desc: Soulbind: Prologue é um jogo de plataforma de ação do gênero Roguelike. O herói é um esqueleto comum e um forasteiro. Mas há um recurso especial: você pode substituir as partes do seu corpo por partes do corpo de seus adversários. Conheça a história de fundo e comece sua jornada no mundo de Allaar

name: Riptide
desc: In Riptide, gear up your ship, customize your loadout, and fight for the fleet! Riptide is a spaceship combat game with an emphasis on powerful customizations and utility. Accomplish your mission by loading up and taking out the enemy.

name: Cyan's Snow House
desc: "Seu lugar é aqui." - "Cyan's Snow House" é um jogo indie curto e sem diálogos, situado em uma vila nevada, oferecendo uma experiência universal e aquecedora de coração em apenas 10 minutos. Desfrute de momentos tranquilos com Cyan e seus amigos animais, deixando uma impressão duradoura.

name: The Storyteller
desc: The Storyteller is an online game where you can build your own turn-based RPG game without any programming and graphic knowledge. Play your world with your friends online, challenge them in turn-based battles, and let them loot and level up after a fiercefull battle while they go through your story.

name: Bugnauts
desc: Embark on a thrilling 3D projectile action adventure in Bugnauts! Swing your net to battle giant bugs and save your island home from an evil resort tycoon. Fight, collect, and explore in this action-packed game for all ages.

name: Brinkmanship
desc: Brinkmanship is a first person sci-fi mystery about greed, manipulation, and trust. As a spaceborne colonist 20 years into your voyage you’ve just discovered that your ship has secretly altered its heading. Your parents give you a gun. The ship goes into lockdown. What do you do? Who will you trust?

name: Lake Minnewaska
desc: Lake Minnewaska is a narrative driven first person fishing game. Fish, explore, and uncover the secrets of Lake Minnewaska as you guide Sosa's journey in becoming a better father.

name: Inline: Out of Time
desc: Complete your delivery routes as fast as possible to appease your corporate overlord while still finding time to enjoy the sights of the retro-futuristic city and your banging tunes.

name: Fallopian Frenzy! Come Again?
desc:
Ten years ago (2014) I made my first game. This is that game. Mostly intact.
I'm sorry.

name: Pogo Rogue
desc: Bounce to the top in this skill based, roguelite action-platformer! Collect powerful items, pick unique weapons, and fight off a variety of enemies while navigating around with a fun, difficult, and unique movement system. Are you up for the challenge?

name: Splash Carnival
desc:
Splash Carnival is roguelike shooting game featuring paintball weapons. 
Arm yourself with diverse low-durability weapons, splash the enemies and move forward! 
Welcome to the Splash Carnival~!

name: Wind Rider
desc: Wind Rider is simple, relaxing gliding game with an endless map and Randomly generated Obstacles. A great game to fill your free time and beat your latest highest score!

name: Kiwie vs Desert
desc: Kiwie vs Desert is a front facing arcade runner starring Kiwie the cat. Throw bombs, equip shields, jetpack over obstacles, and dodge enemies as you navigate through 50 levels of increasing difficulty on your quest to get Kiwie home.

name: unbreaded
desc: Unbreaded is a side-scrolling adventure game where you navigate a gingerbread man through a bakery battleground, blending puzzle-solving with dynamic combat against animated kitchenware, all set within a heartfelt story of creation and rebellion against industrialization.

name: Gooba Ball
desc: A physics-based puzzle game where you combine colorful balls to achieve the ultimate form -- Goober! Combine two of a kind until, like I said, Goober… What more to do you freakin’ want?

name: SMYS : Classic
desc: SMYS : Classic is a 2-4 local multiplayer stairs building race game. This version of SMYS is what the game was planned to be when it was first designed, the Classic version.

name: Crimson Hell
desc: Crimson Hell is a survival-horror game in which you play as Sae, a journalism student determined to find her missing sister. Traverse through three nightmarish realms, collecting limited resources, fighting monsters, and solving puzzles in order to escape and uncover the truth.

name: Terroro
desc: In this psychological horror game about a famous TikToker, you take on the role of her boyfriend to discover that behind their perfect life, nothing is as it seems. Duration 30 minutes.

name: 100 Funny Cats
desc: 100 Funny Cats - Participe da aventura mais fofa em locais temáticos engraçados cheios de gatos! Explore a encantadora arte desenhada à mão do Circo e dos Gatos escondidos por todo o jogo. 🕵️‍♂️❌ Você consegue encontrar todos eles? 🕵️‍♂️🐈✅

name: Content Warning
desc: Filme seus amigos fazendo coisas assustadoras para ganhar fama no SpöökTube! (Recomendamos fortemente não ir sozinho)

name: Evil Sinister
desc: You're a journalist investigating an abandoned house. Armed with only a flashlight, navigate its haunted halls to uncover its secrets. Beware, malevolent forces lurk, blurring reality and nightmare. Will you survive to reveal the truth, or become another victim of its sinister grasp?

name: Speakeasy
desc: An isometric shoot 'em-up minigame set in an underground bar in 1930s Chicago. Speakeasy combines historical charm with edge-of-your-seat action for a gaming experience that’s as thrilling as it is unique.

name: Cat Purrtrol: Find All 100!
desc: Cat Purrtrol: Find All 100! is a relaxing, short game where you find 100 cats hidden in a drawing. It is completely free to play and is a fun quick game to spend a few minutes on!

name: HOLOSAGA: Invasion of the HoloX
desc: Liberated from the shackles of power, Laplace led the HoloX members and the army to invade Earth! You must gather the members of the HoloLive and stop them.

name: Nine Realms: Dawn Touch
desc: Domine o deus do trovão e desafie todos os deuses dos nove reinos! Neste jogo de hack and slash do tipo Rogue, desenvolva sua estratégia e suas habilidades, submeta todos os deuses que o desafiam à sua ira e torne-se o único deus do universo.

name: Ivorfall
desc: Ivorfall City is in danger and only you have what it takes to save it!  Ivorfall is a Steampunk, roguelike, twin-stick shooter where you take up the mantle of Detective Flintlock who must face off against hordes of enemies in destructible environments.

name: SPAM
desc:
SPAM é um jogo de combate por turnos online e gratuito. 
Encare combates dinâmicos nos quais você terá que se adaptar aos seus adversários e tentar impor sua estratégia. 
Conquiste novas cartas com suas vitórias e crie combos devastadores!!

name: Astrometica: Prologue
desc: Astrometica: Prologue is the free game about surviving in space. You need to use your skills and tools to stay alive. There are many challenges to face, and you need to fight to survive. You also need to build a new base in space.

name: Magic Archery
desc: Train a commoner to become the greatest archer in this short incremental game! Increase your stats, gather wealth from quests, buy upgrades, and infuse your arrows with magic.

name: FIND KITTENS: The last of cats
desc: Explore this mysterious post-apocalyptic world by finding cute cats and this black and white world will be colore.

name: Cosmotots
desc: A frantic third-person Team Deathmatch arena shooter. Flank your enemies using hidden teleporters, tunnels, and floating islands. First team to 30 takes the glory. Get your loadout ready, engage in intense matches, and conquer the stars!

name: Playing Kafka
desc: There are things that often fail on nothing but themselves. Is there even a way out? Playing Kafka is a narrative adventure full of impenetrable schemes, insidious plot twists and conversations that slip out of hand. Based on Kafka’s life and his work, developed with Kafka experts.

name: Sobrevivência Veloz
desc:
Survive the darkest hour at UT!
Help Sola defeat shadow monsters wreaking havoc on Speedway using the magical flashlight! Will you be able to rescue Sola's sister, Luna?!

name: Cookard
desc: Cookard is a cooking game where you run a restaurant by stacking cards to prepare and serve dishes to customers.

name: Zombie Battle
desc:
The doctors would like create new humans. Stronger, faster humans. But the humans will be zombies. The zombies killing the doctors!
Your name is 'Joe'. You are Soldier.
You travel the helicopter to Zombie Land, you must save the doctors and kill the zombies.

name: Quackdzilla: Pool Cleaning Simulator
desc: Sinta a atmosfera e o humor específicos do Simulador de Limpeza de Piscinas. Assuma o papel de um garoto da piscina e descubra o destino que o espera no prólogo gratuito do Simulador de Limpeza de Piscina - Quackdzilla🦆!

name: Banana
desc:
Banana is a clicker Game, in which you click a Banana! In Banana you click the Banana to gain even more Bananas!
Every 3 hours, you get dropped a banana. Each banana is also made by the community in discord.
Come hang out with us and let's grow into something awesome !

name: Chocolate Factory: Prologue
desc:
Construa sua fábrica de chocolate dos sonhos para produzir os doces mais saborosos.
Um delicioso jogo de automação de fábrica em primeira pessoa com um pouco de exploração e combate.
O paraíso dos transportadores de confeitaria aguarda!
O prólogo gratuito para o jogo completo!

name: Nightmare Kart
desc: Zoom through gothic streets in this horror themed vehicular combat racing game!

name: Boneless VR
desc: Boneless is an experimental Virtual Reality physics sandbox game built to test the limits of what's possible in VR. The game features unique maps, unique weapons, such as guns and swords and multiple enemies.

name: Miya
desc: The stunning warrior maiden gracefully dances through the battlefield, slicing through demons with her blade, collecting resources, unlocking stunning outfits, and embracing the ultimate thrill of action!

name: ChronoClone
desc: The final project for a team of high school seniors as part of their game design class, Chrono Clone is a free to play puzzle platformer with multiple levels.

name: Clothing Store Simulator: Prologue
desc: Pronto para revolucionar a moda? Comece seu negócio com a Prologue, firmando contratos com marcas, encomendando produtos, organizando corredores, vestindo manequins e iniciando suas vendas. Uma seleção especial de produtos da Prologue está à sua espera.

name: No contact
desc: After being left alone on a delivery ship, you find yourself on a space station that has gone to hell. Navigate through the dark corridors of the station while running and hiding from the dark forces in pursuit. Choose who you can trust, while uncovering the mystery of what happened.

name: 9SHOT
desc:
This game is purely for catharsis; there's no main storyline and it will never conclude
"9Shot" is a first-person shooter game set in a zombie-infested Tokyo streets. Your objective is simple: survive against waves of zombies for as long as possible. Earn points by killing zombies to upgrade weapons

name: Kilonova
desc: Embark on a journey of revenge as Sol, a warrior of the celestial cosmos, as she fights to repel the corruption that has shackled the creatures of a fractured world. Wield her cosmic strength to shatter your foes and expunge the malevolent influence of the cosmos most ancient enemy; The Kilonova!

name: Keeper's Curse
desc: Welcome to the mysterious and haunted island of “Keeper’s Curse”. In this action-packed survival third-person shooter, you’ll face relentless waves of cursed creatures while unraveling the secrets of the island and striving to escape its sinister grasp.

name: LEGO® Harry Potter™ Collection
desc: LEGO®  Harry Potter™ Collection traz LEGO® Harry Potter™: Anos 1 a 4 e LEGO® Harry Potter™: Anos 5 a 7 juntos em um só jogo, agora remasterizado com gráficos aprimorados.

name: IRON NEST: Simulador de Artilharia Pesada
desc: IRON NEST é um jogo brutal de artilharia pesada dieselpunk onde você domina o campo de batalha com uma máquina de guerra colossal. Use medições do mapa com coordenadas recebidas, configure os sistemas hidráulicos e atire os canhões para destruir inimigos ⟹ Você irá obedecer o Alto Comando, Operador?

name: Medved Hellraiser 3: Green Elephant
desc: 3D first-person shooter where you have to fight monsters, gopniks, debt collectors and homeless people!

name: Black Screen
desc: This game is nothing more than a black image covering the entire screen area, without the presence of any incentives.

name: Nightmare House: The Original Mod
desc: Wake up, it’s time for the real nightmare to begin. Make your way through a terrorizing house, uncover the secrets of a haunted hospital, fight through hordes of the undead, and try to escape Nightmare House.

name: Off Air
desc: Jump, slide, and smash your way through an arena of blood thirsty robots in Off Air. A first person shooter where there are only two rule: Survive and Smile for the camera. Use your wits and speed and dodge around waves of enemies in an ever devolving world of chaos and lead.

name: Stairway
desc: Get out of the building via the stairway. Observe the levels carefully for a successful exit.

name: Union of Gnomes: Prologue
desc: O prólogo de Union of Gnomes aguarda por seu olhar ousado e corajoso. Perverso e quebrado, ele permanece — um reflexo do que nunca deveria ter acontecido. Os fios do destino se desfiam, e a realidade se estilhaça como um espelho quebrado.

name: Goblin Kart Rescue
desc: Goblin Kart Rescue is a top-down racing game, with 24 short but challenging tracks against a CPU opponent. After saving all the princesses by winning in story mode, try beating your own time in Time Attack, or see how many races you can clear in the difficult Endless mode!

name: UT Game Design Presents: Banana Cowboy
desc: Play as Banana Cowboy and adventure in fruit-themed universe, rescuing your people from your evil twin who has taken over the Banana Kingdom. Use your trusty lasso and spaceship horse to travel to the Orange Biker and Blueberry Pirate planets and save the universe from the Evil King!

name: Phantom Watcher
desc: Phantom Watcher is a chilling horror-strategy game. Survive the haunted hospital’s mysteries, navigating ghostly behaviors in a unique CRT aesthetic. Each playthrough is a new eerie challenge. Dare to uncover the secrets?

name: Above
desc: ABOVE is a challenging climbing game set in a mysterious world. Reach, jump and grab on to rocks and moving objects as you pave your way through the vertical terrain. Experience a mysterious and intriguing world with gameplay that will challenge both your skills and endurance.

name: Krypta FM
desc: Can you solve the mystery of the Beast of Gozdary?

name: Blood Lust
desc: Fight against your friends in this multiplayer arena combat game and choose between different characters with occult skills.

name: Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas
desc: Defeat legions of pirates and marine beasts to emerge victorious in Ruiga Pirates: Cursed Seas! Adventure with survival elements. Customize your ship, prepare for barrages from myriad foes, and navigate the perilous waters of a monster realm. Embark on this thrilling journey and Play for Free now!

name: Furriend
desc: Help the lonely mage to spawn lots of cute Paw-friends! Furriend is a 2.5D isometric puzzle games that combines connect the dot + merge mechanics.

name: Abyssal
desc: A 3D turn-based strategy game where a Monk, wielding arcane magic, and his minions battle hordes of Eldritch-like creatures.

name: The Big Catch: Tacklebox
desc: Crack open the Tacklebox to show off your platforming prowess and fishing skills in this free prologue to .

name: Emerald Dreams: Sanity -  Platformer Quest
desc: Emerald Dreams: Sanity - Platformer Quest is an exciting 2.5D platformer and adventure Metroidvania that takes you on a journey through mysterious worlds. The game offers a rich story set in a dark fantasy universe where every decision you make can lead to one of multiple endings.

name: Turbo Live
desc: Turbo Live é o party game definitivo para jogar com sua comunidade durante sua transmissão. Salve ou atropele os pedestres pelo chat. Em co-op ou versus. Faça sua audiência crescer, se divirta e crie laços durante sessões caóticas e inesquecíveis!

name: Coloring Game 5
desc: Coloring Game 5 - coloring by numbers.  Is a bright representative of anti-stress games.

name: HackHub: Free Trial
desc: Desvende segredos cibernéticos e frustre a vigilância em massa como um hacker habilidoso em HackHub. Desafie a autoridade, reescreva as regras e emerja como o rebelde digital definitivo.

name: Slash/Jump
desc: How do you platform if walking and jumping aren't an option? With a sword of course! Bounce and slash your way through this short and sweet, uniquely controlled precision platformer!

name: CHROMA
desc: Blast through an army of robots and take down their oppressive corporate empire. Master fast paced movement abilities, combine colors for explosive builds, and make every shot count to beat this back-breaking roguelike shooter.

name: I Have More Hours Than You
desc: I Have More Hours Than You is an Idle game with a loose abstract story about acceptance. But you'll probably just use it to brag about how many hours you have to your friends.

name: As expected of the Demon Lord
desc:
A Sort the Court like, where you play as a Demon Lord in a Dungeon.
Fun and simple sound and art design.
Make decisions by giving Yes or No answers to every creature that comes to you.
Grow your Dungeon, keep your minions happy, earn Gold and be Good or Bad.

name: Hail Britannia
desc: Hail Britannia is a text-based game with lite RPG elements set in an alternate 1944 where the Central Powers won World War 1.

name: Max's Adventure
desc: Max's Adventure is a fun 2D platformer where you guide Max, a playful dog, through fun levels full of obstacles and threats. Play as Max or his friends Cheddar and Brian, each with their own advantages and disadvantages.

name: Fight School Simulator: Prologue
desc: Step into the world of Martial Arts, an immersive FPS Simulation where you take on the role of a martial arts instructor determined to build the ultimate dojo. With this Prologue Demo version, Guide to greatness by mastering martial arts, training your student fighters, and standing up to rivals.

name: Retail Company Simulator: Prologue
desc: Administre sua empresa de varejo neste prólogo gratuito do jogo. Assine contratos com marcas líderes, encomende novos produtos, dê atenção aos clientes e nunca deixe seus clientes saírem de mãos vazias. Contrate funcionários, expanda sua loja e aproveite o crescimento de sua empresa.

name: Reverse: 1999
desc: Reverse: 1999 is a 20th Century Time-Travel Strategic RPG developed by Bluepoch. As the Timekeeper, the observer of eras, you will embark on a journey across time and space, from the Roaring '20s to the turn of the millennium, uncovering the truth about the "Storm" and the mystery of the year 1999.

name: Fast Food Simulator: Prologue
desc: Welcome to the world's most chaotic place! Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players in the free prologue version. Run a fast-food restaurant. Take orders, make burgers,  and increase your earnings by dealing with customers.

name: Quacker Bros
desc: Quack! É HORA DO PAYDAY! Quacker Bros é um jogo frenético de estratégia de defesa de torre. Proteja seu dinheiro suado de um bando de amigos emplumados! Construa um exército quacktastic e utilize uma combinação de suas habilidades. Você precisará de mais do que sorte para deter o golpe das galinhas.

name: Pantheon: Rise of the Fallen
desc: Pantheon: Rise of the Fallen is a deeply social high fantasy MMORPG that challenges its players and rewards effort. Join the denizens of Terminus to uncover the mysteries of a world divided by Celestial loyalty… and betrayal.

name: Gorble
desc: Gorble is a short marble-based dungeon crawl.

name: Recycling Center Simulator: Prologue
desc: Recycling Center Simulator: Prologue é um jogo simulador de negócios gratuito no qual você ganha dinheiro com lixo. Colete matérias-primas para o seu centro de reciclagem de diferentes locais, recicle-os, ganhe dinheiro produzindo novos produtos e melhorando sua fábrica.

name: IDUN Prologue - Frontline Survival
desc: Step into the arena with IDUN: Prologue, a thrilling slice of our full-length defense RTS where real-time strategy meets rogue-lite chaos. Fight your way through unique mission objectives with overwhelming swarms of enemies.

name: Floodcore
desc: Floodcore is a puzzle adventure game in which you explore an ancient civilization in a flooded world, and discover a mysterious power to overcome the temple's challenges.

name: Fear of the Light
desc: A survival horror game where light is scarier than darkness. Use your radar and other tools to stay out of the light, sneak around dangers, explore the quarantined ship, and find a way to escape. But be careful, monsters are hunting you and are aware of your every mistake!

name: Descenso
desc: A very short adventure in which you will explore a futuristic world and a handsome deck.

name: GHUNTER
desc: Become Ghunter, a cook gnome that will create dishes by cooking creatures... ALIVE!! Use your various cooking based weapons to cook your prey alive and brutally finish them off with your multi-purpose melee weapon! Save the Kingdom by submitting your delicious dishes!

name: Plants Huddled Together
desc: Um interessante jogo de quebra-cabeça com peças irregulares, contendo belas ilustrações de plantas. Venha relaxar com este jogo!

name: Backyard Basketball '01
desc: Return to the blacktop with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Basketball 2001 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Dribble, shoot, and take that ball to the hoop!

name: Backyard Hockey '02
desc: Return to the ice with your favorite Backyard athletes! The original Backyard Hockey 2002 is back and now enhanced to run on Steam. Skate, pass, shoot, and score in this classic game!

name: Everything Ends In 0
desc: The world ends in 1 hour. It can't be saved. Wanna chat?

name: Wizards in Shorts
desc: Wizards in Shorts is a fast-paced online arena shooter. Blast your friends with fireballs, electricity, puffer fish, and mysterious blue orbs.

name: Frontline Inferno
desc: Step into fast-paced WWII combat with Frontline Inferno! Choose your side and engage in chaotic, arcade-style battles with dynamic respawns, customizable loadouts, and vibrant low-poly visuals. Join the fight and dominate the battlefield!

name: PUMPKIN PANIC
desc: VENHA PARA ESTA FAZENDA ACONCHEGANTE!  Plante, cuide das plantas, vá pescar ou o que preferir, mas divirta-se! Mas tome cuidado, pois dizem que coisas estranhas estão acontecendo na região...

name: Spellchanted
desc: Enter a magical world filled with legendary Fairy Tale characters. Become the greatest wizard. Help a young witch break an evil curse and save the Fairy Tale kingdoms!

name: AVIÃOZINHO DO TRÁFICO 3:ABRI UM PORTAL PRO INFERNO NA FAVELA TENTANDO REVIVER MIT AIA E PRECISO FECHAR
desc: UM JOGO BOOMER SHOOTER BRASILEIRO FEITO COM O MOTOR ID TECH 2! ATIRE, SALTE, SE AVENTURE POR TODO O ESTADO DO RIO DE JANEIRO, NO INFERNO E ATÉ NO CÉU! SALVE O BRASIL!

name: Veil Transfer
desc: An atmospheric, arcade first-person horror game where your sole job is to root out the Veils who take on the identity of humans. Interrogate and execute monsters that hide within people, and protect yourself while managing your ammunition and transfers.

name: Backrooms: Found Footage
desc: Backrooms: Found Footage is a single-player horror game where you are the main character trying to survive the Backrooms. Curiosity wins and you decide to explore this weird place that you got trapped in. What could go wrong?

name: Find 100 Ducks and Blast Them!
desc: Sim! Neste jogo de objetos escondidos em 3D você deve explodir 100 patinhos de brinquedo! Relaxe, mire bem e deixe as penas voarem! Com uma jogabilidade leve e patinhos fofos para caçar, é uma experiência casual em primeira pessoa cheia de diversão saudável e para toda a família!

name: you're just imagining it
desc: A chronic illness simulator. You think you have a chronic illness, but you don't know what. All you know is you are always in some state of pain. You've been to too many doctors to count... but you still have to live your life.

name: Pizzapocalypse (Student Version)
desc: Jogue como um mestre pizzaiolo, domine a sua pizza para atravessar uma cidade dominada por uma corporação maligna neste jogo cartunesco de plataforma 3D! Um jogo feito por alunos em 12 semanas.

name: Diluvian Ultra: Awakening
desc: Antes que o Senhor dos Enxames despertasse de seu sono para causar uma ruína vermelha entre os invasores de sua nave, ele quase foi destruído por traição. Neste jogo de demonstração, você assume o controle de Qasar, um jovem neonato diluviano que precisa frustrar o plano para destruir seu senhor

name: ISS Simulator
desc: The ultimate space simulator game, precisely modeling the space and space environment inside the International Space Station (ISS).

name: R.E.P.O.
desc: An online co-op horror game with up to 6 players. Locate valuable, fully physics-based objects and handle them with care as you retrieve and extract to satisfy your creator's desires.

name: AWAKEN - Astral Blade: First Contact
desc: Inicie sua jornada neste conto de fadas sombrio. Aventure-se com Tânia nas misteriosas ruínas antigas e descubra os primeiros segredos de suas origens e destino. Você conseguirá sobreviver a esse começo desafiador no lugar mais sombrio e desesperador?

name: Virtual Interactive Fireplace
desc: A cozy, retro-inspired hearth to warm your screen and your spirit.

name: Traveller's Hymn
desc: Traveller's Hymn is a top-down, grid-based, open-world adventure game. Explore a vast land, battle monsters, collect loot, help locals and cook hearty meals while unraveling the mystery behind the land's curse.

name: Dark Goddess of Destruction: Deusa da Destruição
desc: Esta é uma única jogo de batalha de cartas idle que criamos em conjunto com nossos jogadores. Desenvolvemos um sistema de progressão profundo e perfis completos de personagens e monstros.

name: Inkesis
desc: Help Ink, our hero, fight the evil that consumes the forgotten Library of Arga. Collect Knowledge and control your environment to explore this grandiose building, uncover secrets, and forge your own path in this adventure and puzzle game! But beware, your greed could lead you astray...

name: Alarion
desc: Alarion is the world's first realistic, physics-based bird flight simulator, inspired by the common swift. Dodge trees, hunt insects, and explore the world from the sky. Feel the raw sensation of flight as you master high-speed aerobatics and learn to fly by instinct.

name: Wild Ones Battle Stadium
desc: Wild Ones Battle Stadium is a 2D turn-based game where players control animals in battles, earning points, coins, and experience. Customize the game with equipment and pets, join clans, and compete in modes like Battle Royale.

name: 中华一商：传承
desc: Eastern Trade Tycoon: Inheritance is a trading simulator   the game,you can from zero to   trading markets, build a business,earn money,level up, investing accurately, and manage family to become a trading tycoon!

name: Pamina VS Slimes
desc: Pamina VS Slimes is a fast-paced top-down arcade game where you defend your home from endless waves of slimes. Choose from 4 headpattable characters, master elemental strategies, and unleash powerful burst skills across 4  game modes. Get ready for non-stop action!

name: The Happyhills Homicide
desc:
Welcome to Happyhills, the town where you can indulge your deepest desires, make your wildest dreams come true, and slaughter anyone in your path. In this case, all three of these are the same.
Welcome the citizens of Happyhills in your way!

name: Ignited Entry
desc:
Ignited Entry is a full length narrative driven psychological horror game with voice acting, dreamish visuals, and horror elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 

Some doors should never be opened. But you must go in.

name: 遥远的村庄 AN OUTLAND VILLAGE
desc: Father and mother visited their daughter's home in Beijing to discuss their father's understanding of life and memories of their past relationship with their mother. The Story of Chinese Families

name: Five Nights at Roner's: Remastered
desc:
You are an ambitious paranormal investigator searching for his big break. When you're presented the opportunity of a lifetime--$25.99, to be exact, you jump at the offer.

But everything comes with a catch, and Roner and his friends are keen to teach you that...

name: DEMON COMPASS
desc: This occult item will guide you through a bizarre in-between world and help you to confront past demons as well as piece together former memories that may lead to closure. Seek a better understanding of who you were, who you’ve loved and how much you’ve lost in this 3rd person horror adventure game.

name: Conscience
desc: Jack Beckham is found dead, hanging in his apartment alone. Police rule it a suicide. His father, refusing to accept the conclusion, hires you to investigate. Delve into the clues left behind in his apartment to discover what really happened.

name: FREEFLOW
desc: FREEFLOW is a fast-paced, skill-based parkour game. This game is set in a mysterious facility where there is a AI voice explaining what to do and where to go. There is a unknown evil to this facility, can you discover it?

name: Store Wars: Prologue - Multiplayer Shop Simulator
desc: Jogue sozinho ou com até 16 amigos no caótico prólogo de supermercado! Gerencie, expanda e dispute com lojas rivais em uma divertida batalha estratégica. Quem será o maior magnata? Store Wars: Prologue é uma versão limitada do jogo completo.

name: Wanderness
desc: Capture stunning moments with your trusty camera and immerse yourself in a soothing, zen-inspired world that calms your mind and eases anxiety.

name: Bean Battle Brawl
desc: A simple, early beta 3D multiplayer fps!

name: Magic Puzzle King 2
desc: In this free 2D puzzle game, piece together the items your feline friends have knocked off and shattered.

name: Letters from the War
desc: Modern reimagining of text adventure games with a new gameplay and multiple endings. Censor letters coming from soldiers at the front and make the history of your nation.

name: Stellarion
desc: Upgrade your spaceship and conquer the stars in this thrilling space-mining adventure! Mine asteroids, battle enemies, and trade resources for powerful upgrades to customize your ship. Master the galaxy and embark on the ultimate journey!

name: FleshBound
desc: FleshBound is a fast paced and blood pumping demon-slaying speed running first person action platformer with a unique “splatterpunk” aesthetic. Fight, jump and sprint your way through the levels using your hookshot and wall-running skills.

name: Samurai Brothers
desc:
Samurai Brothers is a fast paced shared-screen multiplayer game.
In addition to the solo mode, two modes are available for multiplayer games.
Do you want to fight against your friends ?
Or work as a team against the multitude of enemies ?

name: 10 Seconds
desc: Time loop puzzle horror, where you're stuck in a failed experiment and must escape or face being eaten for eternity.

name: Bongo Cat
desc: O gato Bongo precisa da sua ajuda. O gato Bongo precisa de mais chapéus!!! Toda vez que você pressionar uma tecla, o gato Bongo baterá em sua barra de tarefas. Digite, clique, jogue ou trabalhe para coletar mais pontos. Quais chapéus você encontrará?

name: Mage at Stake
desc: Roguelite wizard game, where you play as a wizard fighting off waves of monsters and bosses using powerful magic, gathering helper bats and perks. Each time you play, you’ll face new challenges in different biomes, making you think on your feet and try different strategies to win.

name: Death Drive
desc: Death Drive is a road trip visual novel inspired by classic American Gothic fiction.

name: ACS
desc: What's more American than Fast Food? How about cooking it with guns! Switch between individual weapons to move ingredients, cook and deliver them to your customers before they lose their patience.

name: Alpha League HD
desc: Alpha League HD é um Auto Chess gratuito baseado em heróis. Na Alpha League, basta escolher e construir seu herói favorito no estilo Roguelike com 12 gêneros de combate diferentes e depois lutar contra os outros 7 Bots ou Jogadores para ser o vencedor.

name: Campoca
desc:
Enter Campoca, where feel-good activities and delightful interactions are yours to enjoy completely for free!

Collect joyful memories and turn your campsite into a charming, heartwarming retreat!

name: Chill with You Lo-Fi Story
desc: "Chill with You : Lo-Fi Story" is a sound novel game where you work alongside Satone, a girl who loves writing stories. Customize lo-fi music, ambient sounds, and landscapes to create a focused environment. As you deepen your bond with Satone, you may discover a special connection with her.

name: Where Winds Meet
desc: Step into an open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China. Uncover the secrets of your own identity as you rise from a humble village wanderer to the sword master of the imperial capital. Learn martial arts and build your reputation as a hero or a bringer of chaos in this free wuxia world.

name: Terrors to Unveil - Day Off
desc: Jack Williams, um homem trabalhador de 26 anos, finalmente tira um dia de folga após uma longa semana de trabalho. Ele decide passar seu dia de descanso em seu chalé tranquilo para um fim de semana de relaxamento. Mal sabia ele o que aconteceria durante sua estadia.

name: Cosmic Drift
desc: Lance foguetes em órbita ao redor dos planetas, encontre uma boa trajetória e assuma riscos para aumentar sua pontuação! Jogue solo, online ou até mesmo no Twitch!

name: Sync Or Sink
desc: Trapped in a sinking submarine, two players must communicate through walkie-talkies to solve puzzles, complete tasks, navigate the depths, and escape before time runs out.

name: Ye Guild Clerk!
desc: A Guilda de Aventureiros está contratando!... No caso, não aventureiros, mas recepcionistas! O seu papel é fundamental: atribua missões, gerencie equipamentos e efetue o pagamento das recompensas. As suas escolhas impactam a história dos aventureiros, seja para o bem ou para o mal...!

name: Mage Arena
desc: A co-op PvP experience about using your voice to cast spells in the Mage Arena to settle an ages-old feud between sorcerers and warlocks.

name: Press A
desc: Extremely realistic simulator with unprecedented features that let you finally vent all the anxiety modern world induces in you.

name: Laugh Track
desc: You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! Choose your scripts, decide what characters to build relationships with, and keep those audience ratings high -- or get cancelled in more ways than one! Welcome to Must See TV.

name: The Darkest Dusk
desc: Jogo clássico de aventura Point-and-Click para vivenciar a sensação dos anos 80 e 90 | Tech-Noir | Pixel Art e estilo retrô | Visual novel interativa

name: Wish Upon a Cat
desc: Embarque em uma pequena e encantadora aventura pelos mundos de vários jogos da Odencat para encontrar um gato que salta entre dimensões nesta curta e emocionante jornada.

name: Gnomeball
desc: Gnomeball is a fast-paced soccer game for 1-4 players, set in a charming miniature garden. Become a goal-scoring machine, pass like a maestro, and channel your inner Messi as you gracefully dribble past defenders!

name: Off Course
desc: Stuck in a time loop, stop the possessed captain's plans in this cooperate-with-yourself puzzle game. Record each pirate’s actions to solve puzzles, interact with adorable animal companions and get to know the brave pirate crew and the bond they share with each other!

name: Polylumina
desc: A colorful rhythm simulation game where you compose polyrhythmic chord progressions and watch them come alive through glowing, reactive visuals.

name: Yuki「清醒梦」
desc: Explore an abandoned school where memories linger longer than the living. Uncover the mystery of your best friend’s disappearance. Dodge bullets.

name: FISH³: FIRST CATCH
